title: Assistant(e) Exploitation
descriptionHtml:
Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que Assistant(e) Exploitation. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Notre mission est d'assurer le transport des personnes en situation de handicap, en apportant une aide précieuse à ceux qui en ont besoin. En tant que assistant(e) exploitation, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la coordination efficace de notre service de transport, garantissant une expérience fluide et ponctuelle pour nos clients. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. Rejoignez-nous pour faire une différence significative dans la vie de ceux qui comptent sur notre engagement et notre expertise.

Vos missions

1.Gestion des appels et suivi des transports

  • Répondre aux appels des conducteurs, des usagers, des clients et des différents interlocuteurs.

  • Écouter les demandes, recueillir les informations et apporter une réponse adaptée.

  • Accompagner les conducteurs par téléphone tout au long de leur service.

  • Suivre les tournées et vérifier que les transports se déroulent correctement.

  • Gérer les imprévus : retards, absences, pannes, problèmes de circulation ou changements de dernière minute.

  • Modifier les tournées et répartir les courses si nécessaire.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard ou de changement.

  • Assurer une permanence téléphonique de 10h à 19h , selon l'organisation du service.

2. Assistance aux conducteurs

  • Répondre aux questions et aux demandes des conducteurs.

  • Leur transmettre les changements d'horaires, de trajets ou de prises en charge.

  • Organiser les remplacements en cas d'absence.

  • Vérifier les prises et les fins de service.

  • Faire le lien entre les conducteurs et le service Exploitation.

  • Veiller au respect des consignes et des règles concernant les temps de conduite, de travail et de repos.

3. Gestion des réservations

  • Enregistrer les demandes de transport.

  • Vérifier et valider les réservations selon les règles du service.

  • Ajouter les nouvelles demandes aux tournées.

  • Prendre en compte les annulations et les changements de dernière minute.

  • Adapter les horaires et les trajets pour organiser au mieux les transports.

  • Vérifier que les informations sont correctement enregistrées dans les outils de travail.

4. Relation avec les usagers et les clients

  • Répondre aux demandes par téléphone avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard, de changement ou de difficulté.

  • Traiter les demandes courantes et les réclamations simples.

  • Transmettre les situations particulières au responsable.

  • Noter et suivre les réclamations et les événements importants.

5. Suivi des incidents

  • Appliquer les consignes prévues en cas d'incident.

  • Évaluer la situation et contacter les secours si nécessaire.

  • Prévenir rapidement le responsable.

  • Suivre l'incident jusqu'à sa résolution.

  • Rédiger un compte rendu et conserver les informations nécessaires au suivi.

6. Gestion du stock de téléphones professionnels

  • Suivre le stock de téléphones de l'entreprise.

  • Réceptionner et enregistrer les nouveaux appareils.

  • Identifier chaque téléphone grâce à son numéro de ligne, son numéro de série et son IMEI.

  • Tenir à jour un tableau indiquant les téléphones disponibles, attribués, en panne, en réparation ou hors service.

  • Préparer les téléphones avant leur remise aux salariés et aux conducteurs.

  • Prévoir des téléphones de remplacement.

  • Anticiper les besoins lors des nouvelles embauches ou des changements de poste.

Profil recherché

  • Vous avez une formation en gestion, administration, transport ou organisation.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise au téléphone et vous vous exprimez clairement.

  • Vous aimez le contact avec les autres et savez répondre avec calme et courtoisie.

  • Vous savez gérer plusieurs demandes en même temps et garder votre calme en cas d'urgence.

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), sérieux(se), réactif(ve) et savez prendre des initiatives.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'informatique et les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel.

  • Vous apprenez facilement à utiliser de nouveaux logiciels et outils numériques.

  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et communiquer avec différents interlocuteurs.

Une première expérience dans le transport, la régulation, la gestion des appels ou un service d'exploitation serait appréciée.

Les qualités importantes pour ce poste : le sens du contact, une bonne élocution, la réactivité, l'organisation, la patience et le sérieux.

title: Associate AI and Data Consultant - Galaxy Graduate Program
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the Celonis Services organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:

  1. Make Celonis Business Critical: Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.
  2. Scale Customer Health: Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.
  3. Focus on High-Value Activities: Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.
  4. Empower Career Growth: Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.

We deliver production-ready Celonis Platform implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a Discover-and-Build approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.

In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy operational, AI-enriched solutions on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.

We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by state-of-the-art AI augmentation, allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the "eyes and ears" in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.

The Role

As an Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program, you will support the end-to-end "Discover-and-Build" journey for our global customers. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. As part of a consulting team, collaborating with more experienced consultants, you will bridge the gap between complex data landscapes and strategic business value. This role is designed for high-potential university graduates who possess a "Business-Critical Mindset" and the ability to understand how technical solutions can impact customer operations and improve efficiency, resulting in platform adoption and long-term ROI for our customers. 

The Work You’ll Do

  • Support Strategic Implementations: Support the implementation of Celonis Platform as a business-critical tool by connecting customer data to actionable strategic outcomes.
  • Execute Discover-and-Build: As part of a project team, participate in process mining discovery activities, data transformation (SQL/Python), and the creation of AI-driven analyses to identify execution gaps.
  • AI-Forward Solutioning: Leverage your technical background to build and deploy "AI-forward" solutions, utilizing Machine Learning and LLM integrations for our most strategic customers.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset.
  • Operational Excellence: Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring "Built-in Quality Control" in every line of code or analysis produced.
  • Cross team collaboration: Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to:
    • Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs
    • Business Apps & Product and Engineering
    • Solution Architecture & Celonis Support

The Qualifications You Need

  • Academic Background: A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • Technical Foundation: Proven experience building technical solutions during your studies or internships. You should be comfortable with Python, SQL, and have a foundational understanding of Machine Learning and AI architectures.
  • Business-Critical Mindset: A strong interest in how technology creates financial value. You are driven by outcomes like ROI, efficiency, and process improvement.
  • Consulting DNA: You are curious, solution-driven, and outspoken. You possess the confidence to manage stakeholders and the skills required to navigate complex corporate environments.
  • Analytical Rigor: The ability to not only focus on "What is the data saying?" and also to recommend "What should the business do, based on the findings?" 
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills in English and German (native/proficient on both), with the ability to translate technical concepts into business impact.
  • You are available to start working full time from February 1st, 2027 onwards, with the rest of our global cohort.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

  • Project Management: Hands-on, proactive ownership of complex projects, including ensuring consistent and reliable communication with multiple client and internal stakeholders and diligent internal documentation

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience selling to banks or wealth managers

  • Industry Knowledge - thorough understanding of the investment industry, its current trends and competitive landscape

  • Professional Network: Strong professional network in the investment industry

  • Location Preference: Preference for candidates located in Berlin / remote Germany and fluent in German (C2 or native)

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

Our Values:

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together

The role is central to delivering market-leading AV strategy across TV, BVOD/VOD, Cinema and YouTube, ensuring excellence across both agency and client investment objectives. This role requires a strong AV practitioner with excellent planning and buying expertise, commercial acumen, and confident leadership skills. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining high standards of output across the team, ensuring strong day-to-day account leadership, and helping push AV recommendations from good to great through audience insight, innovation and joined-up thinking.

Responsibilities of the role include:

  • Leading AV planning and buying across clients such as Nationwide, Audible and JML.

Skills and Experience

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Key skills and experience required:

  • Strong AV planning and buying experience across TV, BVOD/VOD, Online Video, and Cinema.
  • A deep understanding of audience planning and the ability to translate insight into effective AV recommendations.
  • Strong marketplace knowledge, ensuring you’re on top of all relevant industry headlines, viewing trends, content and developments
  • Knowledge and experience with key AV tools and booking systems including (but not limited to) MediaExplorer, DDS, AdvantEdge, techedge, Caria, Prisma and Adwords.

  • Commercially aware, with strong attention to detail across buying quality, value delivery and financial forecasting.
  • Strong understanding of measurement across AV channels, alongside current market challenges and solutions.
  • Comfortable handling complex situations, resolving conflict and proposing clear solutions.
  • Effective delegation and strong team management skills.
  • Confident presenter with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong negotiator with the ability to influence across clients, media owners and internal teams.
  • Proactive, collaborative and pitch-ready, with a future-focused mindset and appetite for innovation.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. title: Associate, Finance Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Communication & Stakeholder Management:

  • Draft clear, concise documentation for data pipelines, dashboard usage, and reporting metrics to ensure global teams can easily understand and leverage your tools.

  • Present analytical findings and AI/ML capabilities confidently to both the Manager and broader global stakeholders.

Data Modeling & Technical Execution:

  • Take technical requirements translated by the Manager and develop robust data pipelines and models to support treasury operations.

  • Extract, transform, and load (ETL/ELT) complex datasets using modern tech stacks including dbt, Google BigQuery, and Snowflake.

  • Ensure data architecture is scalable, reliable, and optimized for rapid querying and analysis.

Reporting, BI & Visualization:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated, user-friendly treasury dashboards and reports using Looker/Tableau/Power BI (or similar tools).

  • Ensure all reports are highly accurate, timely, and aligned with broader business OKRs.

  • Uncover and visualize key trends across all treasury domains to support senior stakeholders.

AI & Advanced Analytics Initiatives:

  • Explore and implement AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to improve treasury insights.

  • Drive continuous improvement by evaluating new tools and methodologies to keep the team’s tech stack at the cutting edge.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field (Not Mandatory).

  • Experience:

    • 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence, preferably within a fintech, banking, payments, or financial services company.

    • Proven track record of working collaboratively and communicating effectively in distributed or cross-regional teams.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Advanced proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehousing (specifically BigQuery and Snowflake).

    • Hands-on experience with data transformation tools (dbt).

    • Strong expertise in building dashboards and visualizations in Looker.

    • Bonus: Practical experience or strong familiarity with integrating AI/ML models or leveraging Python/R for predictive analytics.

Key Competencies:

  • Exceptional Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex, technical data into clear narratives for diverse, global audiences.

  • Technical Agility: Deep understanding of the modern big data tech stack with an appetite for adopting new technologies, particularly in the AI space.

  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Thrives in a globally distributed environment, working seamlessly with diverse teams across borders and cultures.

  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Highly skilled at diving into complex, messy data to extract clean, reliable, and actionable insights.

  • Execution-Oriented: Ability to take high-level objectives and technical tasks delegated by the Manager and deliver scalable solutions efficiently.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

  • One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

  • Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

  • Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

  • Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

  • A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

  • Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: B2B Marketing Graduate at CFO Insights
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next B2B Marketing Graduate.

About us

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

As our B2B Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible 

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Backoffice Manager/in – kaufm. Steuerung & Digitalisierung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest unser Backoffice eigenverantwortlich organisieren, kaufmännische Abläufe steuern, Unternehmenszahlen im Blick behalten und mit KI und digitalen Tools unsere internen Prozesse aktiv weiterentwickeln?

Als zentrale Stütze unseres Teams weißt du, worauf es ankommt, damit im Unternehmensalltag alles rundläuft. Du behältst den Überblick, erkennst vorausschauend, was zu tun ist, setzt die richtigen Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts Wichtiges liegen bleibt. Als vertrauensvolle und zuverlässige Ansprechperson koordinierst du Menschen und Aufgaben mit Fingerspitzengefühl, unterstützt deine Kolleg:innen und packst dort an, wo du gebraucht wirst.

Dabei verbindest du Organisationstalent mit kaufmännischem Verständnis und einem ausgeprägten Gespür für Zahlen. Du erstellst und behältst Abrechnungen, offene Forderungen und kaufmännische Kennzahlen im Blick, erkennst Unstimmigkeiten frühzeitig und sorgst für transparente, strukturierte Abläufe. Gleichzeitig hinterfragst du bestehende Prozesse und findest innovative Wege, diese mithilfe von digitalen Tools und KI einfacher, effizienter und möglichst automatisiert zu gestalten.

Unser Team aus Security-Expert:innen setzt sich leidenschaftlich für den Schutz digitaler Infrastrukturen ein und arbeitet mit viel technischer Freiheit, kollegialer Unterstützung und minimaler Reisetätigkeit in anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten.

Mit langjähriger Beratungserfahrung, agilen Arbeitsweisen und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden branchenneutral und herstellerunabhängig.

Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Bei komplexen Aufgaben findest du immer Unterstützung im Team.

Aufgaben

  • Du organisierst und steuerst unser Backoffice eigenverantwortlich und sorgst für reibungslose administrative Abläufe, eine zuverlässige Termin- und Vertragsverwaltung sowie strukturierte interne Prozesse.

  • Du übernimmst die kaufmännische Administration, einschließlich Projektabrechnungen, Rechnungsstellung, Forderungsmanagement und der Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatung.

  • Du erstellst regelmäßige Management-Reports und bereitest relevante Unternehmenskennzahlen wie Umsatz, Kosten, Forderungen, Projektstände und Plan-Ist-Abweichungen als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Geschäftsführung auf.

  • Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende Prozesse, identifizierst Digitalisierungspotenziale und setzt effiziente, möglichst automatisierte Lösungen eigenständig um.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools und Microsoft 365, um wiederkehrende administrative Tätigkeiten zu vereinfachen, manuelle Aufwände zu reduzieren und die Qualität unserer internen Abläufe kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, HR, Consultants und externen Dienstleistern und unterstützt bei administrativen HR-Themen sowie der Organisation interner Veranstaltungen.

Dabei hast du den Freiraum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und unsere internen Prozesse nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Deine Fähigkeiten (für uns wichtig)

Für uns ist es wichtig, dass Du Spaß daran hast, Neues zu lernen und Dein Wissen weiterzugeben.

Das wünschen wir uns von Dir:

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer kaufmännischen oder vergleichbaren Backoffice-Funktion sowie eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium. Dabei bringst du ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis und eine ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität mit.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit kaufmännischen Auswertungen, Controlling und Reporting und kannst relevante Kennzahlen eigenständig analysieren, verständlich aufbereiten und daraus wichtige Erkenntnisse ableiten.

  • Du bist ein echtes Organisationstalent, behältst auch bei vielfältigen Aufgaben und unterschiedlichen Anforderungen den Überblick und die Freundlichkeit, setzt die richtigen Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts Wichtiges liegen bleibt.

  • Du überzeugst durch deine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke, hast Freude daran, deine Kolleg:innen zu unterstützen, und bist eine zuverlässige Ansprechperson für unterschiedliche Unternehmensbereiche.

  • Du besitzt sehr gute Microsoft-365-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel, SharePoint, Teams und Outlook, und nutzt digitale Tools sicher und effizient im Arbeitsalltag.

  • Du bringst sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten mit, erkennst Zusammenhänge und Verbesserungspotenziale schnell und findest auch für komplexere Aufgaben pragmatische und durchdachte Lösungen.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Copilot regelmäßig und hast Freude daran, administrative Prozesse mithilfe digitaler Lösungen eigenständig zu optimieren und möglichst zu automatisieren.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert, denkst unternehmerisch, handelst vorausschauend und setzt deine Ideen mit Eigeninitiative und Hands-on-Mentalität zuverlässig um.

  • Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektcontrolling mit, vorzugsweise aus einem Beratungs- oder Dienstleistungsunternehmen.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kommunizierst klar, professionell und wertschätzend.

Deine Fähigkeiten (nice to have)

Über folgenden Fähigkeiten von Dir freuen wir uns, ansonsten erlernst Du die Aspekte im Rahmen der Einarbeitung:

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Power BI oder vergleichbaren Reporting- und Automatisierungstools und möchtest datenbasierte Auswertungen und Prozesse weiterentwickeln.

  • Du verfügst über Kenntnisse in DATEV, HubSpot, Jira oder Confluence.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung.

Benefits

  • Selbstverwirklichung: Freiraum zum Ausprobieren, eine offene Fehlerkultur und die Mitgestaltung von Strukturen im Unternehmen sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

  • Spannendes Arbeitsumfeld: Du gestaltest interne Prozesse in einem Unternehmen mit anspruchsvollen Projekten rund um Cyber Security, Cloud und IT-Architekturen.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Arbeite in Deiner produktiven Zeit und plane private Verpflichtungen flexibel ein. Mehrarbeit wird ausgeglichen.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Du hast die Wahl zwischen verschiedenen Angeboten wie
    Deutschland-Jobticket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Kitaplatzes
    Förderung oder Job Rad.

  • Weiterbildungen: Wir investieren in Deine Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Weiterbildungen und renommierte Zertifizierungen.

title: Brand Manager (B2B)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Role overview 🌟

Alan has passed 1M members, works with 40K+ companies and operates in seven countries. New products and a flagship international event are coming, and the Brand team is investing in bigger campaigns. So far brand spend has gone mostly to broad awareness. We now need targeted B2B campaigns for specific verticals (for example TNS, retirees, very small company owners), run alongside the broad campaigns to reinforce them.

You'll own these vertical B2B brand campaigns for France, plus a portfolio of other brand projects. You'll work closely with the Brand Lead, Product Marketing, Growth, segment owners and Sales. This is an individual-contributor role at C1-D level.

What you'll do

  • Vertical campaigns: Define the audience, message, proof points and channels for each priority vertical. Choose priorities and objectives with segment owners, Growth and Product Marketing. Run each campaign from brief to post-mortem, and build reusable toolkits (messaging, assets, case studies) for other teams.

  • Product and offer launches: Support the launch of new product features (e.g. Mo, Alan Précision) and new offers (e.g. Alan retirees) in France. Work in strong collaboration with the Product teams to build a creative, impactful go-to-market that stands out in the market. Turn product positioning into launch plans and assets.

  • Partnerships and events: Run vertical-specific events, sponsorships, ambassador and creator partnerships that build credibility with each audience.

  • Local markets: Give feedback on local briefs and plans. Spot French initiatives that could scale to other markets and capture them in playbooks.

  • Measurement: Set KPIs for every project (reach in the target, qualified leads, pipeline influenced, brand perception). Run test-and-learn with Growth and Data. Manage budgets, vendors and deadlines.

You're a good fit if you

  • Have 7+ years of in-house brand marketing (B2C, B2B or B2B2C). Paid media or media planning is a big plus.

  • Have led at least two B2B campaigns or brand projects end to end, and can walk us through the problem, your choices and the measurable result.

  • Have managed agencies and budgets and made trade-offs when resources were tight.

  • Are a generalist across campaigns, content, partnerships, events and PR, with sharp creative judgment you can defend with senior stakeholders.

  • Set brand KPIs and link brand work to pipeline or lead quality.

  • Work well with Sales and Growth and can influence without authority.

  • Written and verbal communication fluency in English and French

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it.

What You'll Do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it.
  • Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery.
  • Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review.
  • Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves.
  • Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month.
  • Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field.
  • A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures.
  • Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

title: CDI - Context & Analytics Engineer Manager - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages.

Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et le L&D pour analyser les besoins, segmenter les publics et cartographier un workflow.Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation.Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité.Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert.Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées.

title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Chief of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence.

At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence.

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do

  • Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

  • Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

  • Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

  • Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

  • Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

  • Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are

  • A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

  • Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

  • Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

  • A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

  • High ownership and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

  • Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

  • Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

  • A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements

  • Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

  • Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

  • Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

  • Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change.

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence.

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

title: Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy
descriptionHtml:
0.8 – 1 fte week | Utrecht | Hybride | Hbo/wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy. Ben jij een expert op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en privacy en combineer je inhoudelijke kennis met een pragmatische aanpak? En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties.

  • Periodiek rapporteren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy aan de directie en het management, met concrete aandachtspunten en voorstellen voor verbetering.

  • Het signaleren en beoordelen van risico’s en het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en DPIA’s samen met collega’s.

  • Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001.

  • Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken.

  • Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

  • De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je korte lijnen hebt met collega’s en de ruimte krijgt om verbeteringen voor te stellen en op te pakken.


Dit neem je mee

Je hebt een stevige basis in informatiebeveiliging en privacy en vindt het leuk om zaken daadwerkelijk voor elkaar te krijgen. Je kunt beleid en risico’s vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en voelt je prettig in een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Tegelijkertijd heb je de ambitie om je verder te ontwikkelen en op termijn ook meer strategische verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Daarbij neem je mee:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau; bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van securitymanagement, bestuurskunde of bedrijfskunde.

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring en relevante ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en/of privacy.

  • Kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en normenkaders, zoals de AVG, BIO, ABRO, NIS2, NEN7510 en ISO 27001.

  • Het vermogen om risico’s en beleid te vertalen naar concrete, werkbare maatregelen en acties.

  • Een praktische en zelfstandige houding: je adviseert, organiseert én pakt zelf zaken op.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatiesensitiviteit, waardoor je collega’s kunt meenemen en verschillende belangen bij elkaar kunt brengen.

Certificeringen als CISSP, CISM, CISA, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPM en CDPO zijn een pré, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker vinden we dat je de inhoudelijke basis en motivatie hebt om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.
