title: Corporate Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll work closely with Corporate Development on strategic transactions such as fundraising and M&A, partner with UK and regional leaders on new-market entry, support licence expansion, and help align Airwallex’s global policies and governance with UK and relevant EMEA requirements. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth.

  • Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance.

  • Partner with the business, Regulatory Legal and Regulatory Compliance teams on expansion into and launches in new markets across the UK and EMEA, including regulatory mapping, entity and licensing considerations, and corporate governance requirements.

  • Align Airwallex’s policies, procedures and corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions, with particular focus on UK requirements.

  • Draft, review and negotiate referral agreements, marketing and sponsorship agreements, and other commercial arrangements, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and documented.

  • Advise on marketing, advertising and promotions, including claims, disclosures, digital campaigns, co-marketing and referral programmes, while supporting the review of customer-facing materials for legal and regulatory compliance.

  • Coordinate and manage outside counsel on specialised matters in the UK and across EMEA, ensuring advice is high-quality, cost-effective and aligned to Airwallex’s risk appetite and business goals.

  • Use technology and AI-enabled tools, including templates, playbooks, contract lifecycle tools and knowledge bases, to increase the speed, consistency and quality of legal work.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Qualification as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another UK jurisdiction, and in good standing with the relevant professional body.

  • Proven experience in financial services and corporate law, preferably gained at a fast-growing technology or fintech company and/or a top-tier law firm.

  • Demonstrated interest in financial services regulation and the fintech industry, with willingness to go deep on payments, e-money, money services and related regulatory topics in the UK and EMEA.

  • In-depth knowledge of, or strong familiarity with, the UK legal and business environment, including how UK legislation, FCA requirements and cross-border rules impact fintech and payments businesses.

  • Proven experience drafting and negotiating corporate and commercial agreements, with strong written and verbal communication skills that make complex issues clear to non-lawyers.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Compliance, Risk and Marketing, across time zones.

  • Demonstrated capability in managing and leading outside counsel, including scoping work, controlling costs and consolidating advice into clear recommendations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical, business-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting fundraising transactions, M&A or strategic investments, including due diligence and deal execution, ideally in a technology or fintech context.

  • Prior in-house experience in a fintech, payments or broader financial services company, particularly one operating across the UK and multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Experience advising on legal issues related to marketing, advertising and promotions, including digital marketing, performance marketing, referral programmes and brand partnerships.

  • Exposure to UK financial services regulatory frameworks, including the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, the Payment Services Regulations 2017, the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, FCA rules and guidance, and applicable financial promotions requirements.

  • Experience partnering with Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance or licensing teams on market expansion initiatives and regulatory change.

  • Comfort using technology, AI and legal operations tools to increase the speed and quality of legal work, for example playbooks, templates, contract lifecycle tools or knowledge bases.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

Legal sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the builders transforming us into a generational financial company, working alongside product, sales, and business partners every step of the way. You'll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while keeping our brand and data architecture best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the discipline that protects the moat.

It's a team for lawyers, strategists, and licensing specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Data & AI Engineer (Frankfurt or Munich, Germany)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a leading Data & AI services company helping large organisations turn data and AI into measurable business value. We work with major enterprises across industries including pharma, chemicals, manufacturing, financial services and automotive, solving complex problems across operations, R&D, customer experience and core business processes. Today, Unit8 brings together 170+ engineers, data scientists and consultants across Europe and North America, with a growing presence in the Middle East. We have delivered more than 350 Data & AI projects, spanning GenAI and AI engineering, data platforms, cloud, machine learning and advanced analytics.

Our Mission

Our mission is to help organisations make Data & AI work in the real world. We combine strong engineering, technical expertise and business understanding to take ideas from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment and adoption.

Requirements

About You

As a Data & AI engineer, you build the technical side of client projects, going from a business problem to a solution running in production. You help work out what the client actually needs, design the parts you own and write most of the code yourself. You work in a small project team with a technical lead, and you talk directly with the client's engineers and users.

This role is for engineers who want to own real pieces of client work end to end and grow their impact, while staying hands-on.

What You’ll Do

    • Build the solution: design and write tested, maintainable production code for GenAI applications (agents, RAG, LLM apps) or data platforms and pipelines, and get it running for real users.
    • Own your part: take responsibility for a component or workstream, from design to deployment, and deliver it with limited supervision.
    • Work with the client: understand their business problem, help turn it into clear requirements, and explain your technical choices and trade-offs to stakeholders.
    • Own the quality: be accountable for what you ship, backed by testing, documentation and code reviews with your team.
    • Learn and share: grow quickly alongside senior engineers, and share what you learn with the rest of the team.

Why You'll Love It

    • Solve problems that matter: work directly with clients on complex challenges where Data & AI materially improves how their business runs.
    • Build, not just advise: you ship code that runs for real users, not slide decks.
    • Work at the edge of Data & AI: GenAI and agents, AI engineering, modern data platforms.
    • Work with people who raise the bar: deeply technical engineers and data scientists who care about solving hard problems and will help you grow.
    • Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself.

Who You Are

    • 2 to 4 years of experience building software, data or AI systems, and you are hands-on: you have written production code in Python in the last 3 months.
    • Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production.
    • Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code.
    • Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs.
    • You have owned technical work end to end: a feature, a component or a pipeline you were responsible for.
    • You learn fast and look for feedback: you want to improve your code and your craft.
    • You enjoy working with clients and can explain technical choices clearly. Experience in consulting or another client-facing environment is a plus.
    • Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus.

How We Hire

Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Work on client projects that have a concrete impact on their business.
  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different
  • Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts) or building our own MLOps platform.
  • Tailor-made mentorship programme.
  • Learning activities such as ML and Engineering Knowledge Sharing Groups.
  • Up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing service company with a start-up atmosphere.
  • Work with an international team made of more than 15 nationalities.
  • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events (off-site or on-line).
  • Fun Fund to spend with the team on after-work activities.
  • Compensation package including base salary and profit sharing based on the performance of the company
  • Extended parental leave conditions.

Why Unit8?

At Unit8, we don’t just turn data into value – we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here.

  • Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture.
  • Meaningful Work: You drive things that matter and make others' projects easier through your work.
  • Passion-Led Projects: We provide the environment where you can pursue your passion alongside top talent. If you are excited about the future, you belong with us.

London (Waterloo) · Full-time · Hybrid, three days per week in the office

Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property.

We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents.

We’re looking for someone to own that foundation.

The opportunity

You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have.

The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform.

There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own data as a product. Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable.

  • Be opinionated about sources and quality. Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled.

  • Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Ingest updates from sources such as HMRC and other relevant authorities, detecting changes promptly and turning them into usable, traceable data.

  • Make data usable by our intelligence layer. Structure and serve information so our products and AI agents can retrieve the right facts in context. Preserve source provenance, geographic scope and effective dates so consumers can distinguish current information from historical or superseded guidance.

  • Design for international expansion. Build shared models and ingestion patterns that accommodate differences in property markets, tax systems and regulation. When we expand geographies, we want to go at speed, without rebuilding the platform.

  • Own reliability throughout the lifecycle. Build monitoring, validation and recovery into ingestion, transformation, storage and serving. Know what is stale, missing or incorrect, understand the customer impact and address the root cause.

  • Set the technical direction and deliver it. Make clear trade-offs between immediate product needs and long-term architecture. Ship useful improvements early, document decisions and help shape the standards and future team needed to support the platform.

What you bring

  • Experience owning substantial data systems. You’ve designed, built and operated production data platforms or major parts of them, and can explain the architectural decisions you made and their consequences.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals. You bring strong SQL, data modelling and production programming skills, with practical experience in orchestration, testing, deployment and operating reliable pipelines.

  • Judgment about the data itself. You can evaluate whether a source is fit for a particular use, reconcile inconsistent information and make uncertainty or gaps visible to downstream consumers.

  • Experience with messy external sources. You’ve handled inconsistent formats, changing schemas, incomplete records, rate limits and integration failures. You’re comfortable working beyond clean, well-documented APIs.

  • A product mindset. You care about the decisions your data supports. You can work with domain experts and product engineers to translate an ambiguous need into a useful data product.

  • Architectural ownership. You can review an existing system, establish a direction and deliver improvements incrementally. You understand access controls, privacy and the responsibilities that come with combining customer and external data.

  • Clear communication and initiative. You surface problems early, write down decisions and challenge assumptions constructively. You’re comfortable making progress without a fully specified ticket.

Bonus

  • Experience building data foundations for AI products, including retrieval, document processing or evaluating the quality of information supplied to agents.

  • Experience modelling policy or regulatory information, including versioning and effective dates.

  • Experience with property, financial services, geospatial data or international datasets.

  • Familiarity with GCP, where we run our infrastructure, and experience working alongside backend engineering teams.

  • Experience establishing data standards or helping build a data team.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You just want to keep the pipelines running. You’ll need to care about which data we use, whether it can be trusted and how it improves the decisions our products support.

  • You want a fully specified architecture to implement. We need someone who can assess what exists, challenge assumptions and take ownership of the technical direction.

  • You only want to work with clean, structured data. Important information arrives through documents, policy announcements and inconsistent external sources. Making it usable is part of the job.

  • You want to stay removed from the product or domain. You’ll work closely with product engineers and property experts. Understanding what the data means and how it is used is essential.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own a data platform central to GetGround’s next phase of product development.

  • Turn deep property expertise into intelligence that helps real investors.

  • Work on challenging problems across customer data, property information, AI and regulated services.

  • Shape the architecture for international expansion and help build our future data organisation.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

Diversity & inclusion at GetGround: We encourage applications from all sections of society and we believe in the criticality of an inclusive culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other basis as protected by law.

  • 42% of our employees identify as female or non-specified, 58% as male

  • 22 nationalities represented across offices in 5 countries

  • Our work on Design Accessibility

  • Inclusion is at the heart of our culture - we celebrate and reflect on key D&I and cultural events such as: Black History Month, International Women's Day and Pride

descriptionHtml:

Skills:

4. Tech Stack

5. Languages

descriptionHtml:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning - building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity - moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

What you'll do

  • Apply classical machine learning and deep learning methods to data analysis problems.

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

title: Design Engineer (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Heartworking in Hannover. In Voll- oder Teilzeit. Hybrid.

Wir suchen jemanden, der/die Interfaces gestaltet und baut – und Verantwortung für das Produkt übernimmt, bis es im Browser genauso gut funktioniert wie in der Vorstellung. Tarifrechner, Kundenportale, Antragsflows, Konfiguratoren, Websites – Anwendungen, bei denen hunderttausende Menschen nicht merken sollen, wie komplex "das unter der Haube" ist. Die WordPress-Landingpage von der Stange gibt's woanders.

Aufgaben

So sieht dein Alltag aus

  • Du entwirfst und baust Interfaces – vom Konzept über den visuellen Entwurf bis in den funktionierenden Code. Du kannst ein Feature von der Idee bis in den Browser bringen, ohne es abgeben zu müssen. Das heißt nicht, dass du alles alleine machst – im Team arbeiten Entwickler:innen mit dir im selben Codebase. Aber du bist nicht abhängig davon, dass jemand anderes deinen Entwurf interpretiert.
  • Du arbeitest mit modernen Tools, die die Grenze zwischen Design und Code auflösen – Nordcraft, Cursor, v0 und was sonst in der Praxis taugt. Genauso selbstverständlich schreibst du eigenen Code, wenn das die bessere Lösung ist. Du evaluierst neue Ansätze mit Neugier, aber ohne Hype: nicht jedes Tool, das in der Community trendet, verdient deine Zeit.
  • Du baust und pflegst Design-Systeme dort, wo sie hingehören: im Code. Tokens, Komponenten, Varianten, Dokumentation – als lebendiges System, das direkt im Produkt funktioniert.
  • Du sitzt mit den Entwickler:innen zusammen – wirklich, nicht bildlich. Ihr arbeitet im selben Codebase, reviewed euch gegenseitig, diskutiert Architektur und Umsetzung auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Kundenteams (ca. 4–8 Personen aus Beratung, PM, Design und Development) – direkt am Kunden. Du bist nicht nur für deinen Teil zuständig, sondern denkst über den gesamten Produktkontext mit. Auch nach dem Go-Live.
  • Du denkst in messbarer Wirkung: Analytics, Heatmaps, Conversion-Daten – du nutzt sie, um deine Designentscheidungen zu validieren und das Produkt kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
  • Du machst andere besser: Design-Reviews, Code-Reviews, ehrliches Feedback, Wissenstransfer. Du bewegst dich zwischen Design- und Dev-Welt und bringst beide Seiten näher zusammen – durch gemeinsame Sprache, nicht nur durch Tools.
  • AI ist für dich Werkzeug im Alltag. Du nutzt Cursor für Code-Generierung, v0 für schnelle UI-Exploration, Claude oder ChatGPT für Prototyping und Konzeptvalidierung. Und du weißt, dass gute AI-Ergebnisse davon abhängen, wie präzise du den Kontext definierst: Design-System-Regeln, technische Constraints, Markensprache. Sauber denken, bevor du loslegst.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von Design und Frontend-Entwicklung. Du kommst entweder aus dem Design und hast dir Code beigebracht, oder aus der Entwicklung und hast ein starkes Gespür für Gestaltung entwickelt. Beides ist willkommen.
  • Du kannst Interfaces entwerfen UND bauen: HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript/TypeScript. Du fühlst dich in Figma genauso wohl wie in VS Code oder Cursor.
  • Konzeptionelles Denken: Du verstehst, wie Informationsarchitekturen und User Flows funktionieren, und kannst diese in deinen Entwürfen und deinem Code gleichermaßen abbilden.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit modernen Frontend-Technologien – React/Next.js bevorzugt, aber wenn du aus einem anderen Ökosystem kommst und schnell lernst: gerne. Erfahrung mit Nordcraft oder vergleichbaren visuellen Development-Plattformen ist ein Plus.
  • Design-Systeme lebst du im Code: Tokens, Komponenten, Varianten – aufbauen, dokumentieren, weiterentwickeln.
  • Visuelles Gespür: Typografie, Farbe, Spacing, Responsive Design, Animationen – du erkennst, wenn etwas nicht stimmt, und du kannst es selbst fixen. Accessibility (WCAG) gehört für dich zur Grundhaltung.
  • Kommunikation: Du kannst Designentscheidungen gegenüber dem Team und Kunden argumentieren. Und du sprichst die Sprache beider Seiten – du erklärst Entwickler:innen, warum ein Detail wichtig ist, und Designer:innen, warum eine technische Einschränkung kein Kompromiss sein muss.
  • Du hast echte Erfahrung mit AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag – nicht als Experiment, sondern als festen Teil deines Workflows. Du weißt, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringen und wo du besser selbst baust. Und du verstehst, dass die Qualität der Ergebnisse von der Qualität deines Denkens abhängt – nicht vom Tool.
  • Du kannst dich in komplexe Fachlichkeiten einarbeiten und bleibst auch bei langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen neugierig, statt auf Autopilot zu schalten.
  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau – unsere Kunden und Workshops sind deutschsprachig. Englisch im Code und in der Dokumentation ist selbstverständlich

Du entsprichst nicht zu 100% allen Anforderungen, aber die Chemie stimmt? Kein Problem! Richtig Bock auf Digitales ist uns wichtiger als ein shiny Lebenslauf.

Benefits

Nicht wegen Kontrolle, sondern weil wir glauben, dass echte Kreativität vom Austausch in einem Raum lebt – vom Miteinander zwischen Menschen, das kein Call ersetzen kann. Jeden zweiten Dienstag: Agentur-Standup und gemeinsames (veganes) Mittagessen mit Catering.

  • Moderne Tools: GitHub, Linear, Slack, Figma. Und ja, wir setzen AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag ein – kein Verbot, kein Hype, sondern pragmatischer Einsatz.

descriptionHtml:

Zilch's DevOps team is a small team with a large surface area: four engineers supporting an engineering organisation of over a hundred. The team's mission is to make engineering at Zilch faster, safer, and less painful, by building tooling and automation that lets product teams focus on shipping rather than fighting their environment.

We're looking for a software engineer who cares deeply about developer experience. Someone who's spent enough time building products to know where the friction is (slow feedback loops, flaky pipelines, manual toil, poor tooling) and who wants to fix those problems properly. Not with quick patches, but with well-built internal tools that engineers actually want to use.

You'll own problems end-to-end: understanding what's slowing engineers down, deciding what to build, building it, and driving adoption. The role blends product thinking with hands-on engineering; you'll shape what the team works on as much as you'll write the code.

One example of what this team builds: our ephemeral environments platform, which spins up full, sandboxed copies of the Zilch stack on demand for development, debugging, and automated testing. It's integrated into the PR workflow, backed by its own orchestration engine, and has fundamentally changed how engineers work here. You'd be working with and extending capabilities like this.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape how an engineering organisation works; not just keep the lights on.

title: Director Enterprise Planning and Transformation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

Own the enterprise planning framework that translates company vision and strategy, through commercial growth and customer demand, into aligned product development and operational plans. Bring together Commercial, Engineering, Programmes, Operations and Finance to create one funded, resourced and governed business plan. Lead the transformation, process architecture and resilience needed to deliver it.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

Enterprise planning — primary accountability

  • Vision and strategy into plans: Translate strategic objectives into a 3–5-year enterprise roadmap, annual business plan and rolling 36-month demand and delivery plan. Define planning assumptions, milestones, owners and dependencies across functions and sites.
  • Commercial demand and growth: Work with Commercial to translate customer needs, contracts, pipeline and growth opportunities into demand scenarios by product, configuration, launch date and site. Distinguish committed demand from probable and aspirational growth, making assumptions and confidence explicit.
  • Product development alignment: Integrate the product roadmap, development priorities, engineering resources, qualification and test campaigns, configuration changes and industrialisation milestones. Reconcile customer needs and market timing with product readiness, including development demand competing with production capacity.
  • Operations and capacity: Translate launch demand into rocket, subsystem, supplier, manufacturing, integration, test and logistics requirements. Align workforce, equipment, inventory, footprint and launch infrastructure plans; expose constraints and define interventions, owners and required-by dates.
  • Financial reconciliation and choices: With Finance, reconcile revenue, cost, cash, working capital and capital investment. Quantify demand, product and capacity scenarios; recommend prioritisation, make/buy, investment and timing decisions that balance growth, readiness and affordability.
  • SIOP and execution linkage: Implement monthly Demand Review, Supply and Capacity Review, Integrated Reconciliation and Executive SIOP. Connect 0–6-month execution, 6–18-month capacity and 18–36-month strategic planning to the longer-term roadmap. Baseline approved commitments, control changes and track decisions into delivery.

Transformation and enterprise governance

  • Transformation and process architecture: Lead the transformation portfolio required to execute the enterprise plan. Own end-to-end business process architecture, owners, interfaces and controls, aligned with the QMS and digital roadmap. Track milestones, adoption and verified benefits.
  • Risk, continuity and governance: Own business risk and continuity frameworks, impact assessments, recovery priorities and exercises. Establish weekly delivery visibility, monthly SIOP, quarterly enterprise/investment reviews and annual Board planning inputs, with clear escalation, decisions and action closure.

Required implementation outputs

  • Mobilise the framework: Agree the executive sponsor, process owners, calendar, common definitions, data sources, planning horizons, change rules and decision rights. Launch SIOP in parallel with development of the wider framework.
  • Establish the first integrated plan: Lead a six-week mobilisation, targeting the first Demand Review within two weeks. Deliver a 36-month demand/launch plan, aligned development and rocket production plans, global capacity model, constraint and investment roadmap, and executive dashboard.
  • Make it executable: Secure functional ownership of assumptions and actions; present gaps, scenarios and recommendations for executive approval. Embed the plan in budgets, resource commitments and functional delivery reviews, with continuity gaps and recovery actions tracked.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Enterprise planning: Senior experience building integrated business planning or SIOP in aerospace, space or complex manufacturing. Proven ability to connect strategy, commercial growth, product development, operations and financial plans across functions and sites.
  • Transformation and resilience: Track record in cross-functional transformation, business process architecture, governance and business continuity, including impact assessments, recovery planning and exercises.
  • Judgement and leadership: Strong scenario modelling, capacity planning and financial understanding. Able to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions and turn complex choices into clear decisions and accountable delivery. Relevant qualification or equivalent experience.
  • AI and digital capability — required: Demonstrable practical use of AI and automation to improve departmental efficiency, analysis or planning, with measurable results. Experience connecting planning information across enterprise systems and maintaining reliable data and appropriate controls.

Aim radically high • Deliver, no excuses • Act with trust and integrity • Mission first, always

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

title: Director of Engineering - Customer Workflows
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin’s Engineering org has grown rapidly to more than 150 engineers across multiple tribes, and we are continuing to expand.

AI sits at the centre of what we ship to customers and of how our teams design, build and release software. We are seeking a Director of Engineering to set the technical vision and lead multiple high-impact teams responsible for our Customer Workflows area: the AI-powered workflows our customers use every day to do their jobs in global credit markets.

This role requires a deeply technical, AI-first leader who owns delivery end to end and understands how engineering drives the commercial success of the business. You will lead by example, establishing a culture of engineering excellence where teams tackle complex challenges, innovate boldly, and grow their skills.

We are looking for an experienced leader who has built and shipped AI products that end users rely on. You will help define architecture, set direction for the area, and inspire and empower leaders and ICs to deliver at scale, while staying close enough to the details to review a design, debug a hard problem or pick up the code yourself if it matters.

As Director for Customer Workflows, your role is to amplify the impact of your teams, making strategic decisions that shape the long-term direction of the area. You will ensure reliability, enable rapid innovation, and create the conditions for lasting technical and cultural impact. You'll help shape how a 150+ person engineering org works in an AI-native way, and you'll be measured on what reaches customers and what it does for the business.

Customer Workflows: This is our most customer-facing engineering area. Our customers don’t want another dashboard; they want their work done faster and better. Customer Workflows builds the AI-driven products that make that happen, from the first prototype through to production at scale.

Your customers are the credit professionals using 9fin daily, and the Product, Design and Commercial partners who build alongside you. Your job is to turn their real workflows into products people rely on. That takes a product mindset (know who you serve, prioritise ruthlessly, measure adoption and impact) and deep engineering rigour (reliable, observable, secure AI systems that hold up in production) in equal measure.

 

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s a dose of the kind of things you’ll be doing:

  • Provide strategic & technical leadership over multiple teams in the Customer Workflows area, ensuring alignment with company objectives and technical direction.

  • Lead, coach and inspire Engineering Leads, and grow them and your ICs into stronger leaders with wider technical reach.

  • Set the long-term technical vision for AI workflow products, driving architectural decisions on LLM-powered systems, evaluation, orchestration and the product surfaces customers touch.

  • Stay hands-on where it counts: go deep on designs, reviews, incidents and hard technical trade-offs, and set the bar by doing, not just directing.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Commercial and Customer teams to understand how your area drives revenue and retention, and prioritise the work that moves the business.

  • Work closely with the Head of AI and other Engineering leaders to align technical direction, share expertise and deliver successful outcomes.

  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence through mentorship, standard-setting, and championing robust engineering practices across teams.

  • Own hiring for your area, partnering with the VP Engineering and our People and Talent teams to build strong, AI-fluent teams.

  • Own delivery for the area end to end: set commitments with Product, track them, and be accountable for outcomes across large cross-team programmes.

  • Oversee technical operations and incident response practices across teams, ensuring high system reliability and actionable learning from incidents.

  • Identify and drive systemic improvements to engineering velocity, quality and security, building security in from the start and adopting tooling, including AI, where it measurably helps teams ship faster and safer.

 

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Are a deeply technical engineering leader with a software development background, with a track record of leading multiple teams and managers in complex, high-growth environments.

  • Technical in practice: Earn technical credibility with senior engineers: you review designs in depth, challenge architecture constructively, and can still get hands-on when needed.

  • Have built and shipped AI products that end users interact with, and can speak in detail about the architecture, trade-offs and results.

  • Are AI-first in practice: you can describe concretely how you use AI in your own day-to-day work, how you’ve changed the way your teams build with it, and the impact on delivery.

  • Combine people leadership with technical depth. You inspire Engineering Leads, lead by example and earn credibility through the quality of your thinking.

  • Think commercially and with a product mindset: you understand how your work drives revenue and retention, and you balance customer experience, architecture and resilience accordingly.

  • Have defined, owned and executed technical strategy, scaled systems, and tied engineering investment to business outcomes.

  • Lead with empathy, communicate clearly and influence across engineering, product, design, commercial and executive leadership.

  • Develop senior engineering talent, build succession plans, and create an inclusive environment where leaders grow their impact.

  • Are judged on impact and ownership, not headcount. You’ve scaled alongside a business and stayed close to the technical work as you did.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Director, Strategic Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Director, Strategic Intelligence

CreatorIQ's Strategic Services organization delivers scoped, professional-services engagements that help the world's leading brands and agencies get more from their creator investment. As Director, Strategic Intelligence, you'll lead the Strategic Intelligence and Reporting & Data teams while owning a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end to end, from scoping through analysis to customer presentation. You'll set the quality bar for everything the team delivers, serve as the first escalation point for complex analytical questions, and shape how the practice scales, turning CreatorIQ's data and our customers' own data into the measurement, insight, and recommendations behind some of the largest creator programs in the world.

You'll also help shape how Strategic Intelligence scales: deciding which requests we take on, turning repeat asks into standard offerings, and building the operating rhythm that keeps the team focused, billable, and set up to grow.

The ideal candidate brings senior marketing-science depth and the presence to lead a CMO-level conversation. You know how to measure creator and media impact rigorously, you can tell a clear story with data, and you've led and developed analysts. You're comfortable directing technical work in SQL, Python, and data pipelines, partnering closely with the specialists who build it.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end to end, including scoping, analysis, customer presentation, and handling pushback, so recommendations land with senior stakeholders.

  • VP Partnership: Act as the VP, Strategic Intelligence's stand-in on customer calls and deliverables, and partner on practice strategy, priorities, and the largest enterprise engagements.

  • Team Leadership: Lead the Strategic Intelligence and Reporting & Data teams, setting priorities, coaching analysts and managers, building clear development paths, and owning time tracking, capacity planning, and delivery hygiene.

  • Quality & Escalation: Review the team's work before it reaches customers and serve as the first escalation point for complex analytical and methodological questions.

  • Measurement & Methodology: Bring senior marketing-science rigor to every engagement, including earned and social media value, return on creator spend, marketing mix and incrementality approaches, and disciplined, defensible claims.

  • Scoping Intake: Own intake for smaller and non-strategic analytical requests, deciding whether to take them on, productize them, or decline, and partner with Directors of Services on scope and pricing.

  • Productization: Turn repeat requests into standard offerings, reports, and playbooks that Sales and Customer Success can position with confidence.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Influencer Marketing Services, Platform Services, Customer Success, Sales, and Product so insights shape strategy from the start and customer feedback reaches the roadmap.

  • Thought Leadership: Help shape Strategic Intelligence's point of view on creator measurement, contributing to frameworks, benchmarks, and content that elevate CreatorIQ in the market.

Who you are and what you'll need for this position:

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing science, insights, measurement, or analytics consulting at a brand, agency, media owner, research firm, or marketing technology company.

  • Marketing Science Depth: Senior expertise in marketing and media measurement, including earned and social media value, return on creator spend, marketing mix modeling or incrementality approaches, and the discipline to keep claims defensible.

  • Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of creator marketing and social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and others), including how programs are planned, measured, and optimized.

  • 3+ years leading or mentoring analysts or insights teams, including reviewing work and developing talent.

  • Proven experience owning customer relationships and presenting to senior stakeholders up to CMO level, with the confidence to handle pushback and defend a point of view.

  • Strong data storytelling skills, written and verbal, with the ability to make complex findings clear and actionable for executive audiences.

  • Comfortable directing technical analytical work, including SQL, Python, and data pipelines, in partnership with technical specialists.

  • Experience scoping analytical work, managing capacity across multiple engagements, and flagging risk early.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and managing multiple priorities at once.

  • AI Strategic: Identifies, builds, or directs AI-enabled workflows, automations, or systems that improve business processes beyond individual use and drive measurable impact.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python.

  • Direct experience with the CreatorIQ platform or comparable creator marketing technology.

  • Experience building or productizing analytical offerings, such as standard reports, benchmarks, or packaged services.

  • Experience in a professional-services or consulting environment with utilization or billability targets.

  • Experience supporting enterprise brands across categories such as beauty, CPG, retail, or consumer tech, across global markets.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

  • Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

  • Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für unsere digitalen Vertriebskanäle, kanalübergreifend über Webshop, Amazon, Otto und weitere Plattformen

  • Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung im Bereich E-Commerce, Wirtschaft oder Marketing

Freu dich auf ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem eine offene Du-Kultur selbstverständlich ist. Kurze Entscheidungswege, agile Methoden und ein Team aus motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen sorgen dafür, dass Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden können.

Weiterentwicklung & Support: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, mit verschiedenen Weiterbildungsangeboten und einem individuellen Development Budget.

Über uns

Vier Generationen, eine Vision: die Gestaltung der Zukunft des Schlafes!

Schlafgut, sind das nicht die mit den Spannbettlaken? Ganz richtig, mit schlafgut haben wir das Spannbettlaken erfunden. Doch mittlerweile sind wir einiges mehr und haben noch viel vor.

1927 gründete Adam Matheis ein Textilunternehmen in Eislingen und hat wahrscheinlich gar nicht zu träumen gewagt, wo das ganze hinführen könnte. Fast 100 Jahre später ist mittlerweile sein Enkel Max Mödinger am Steuer, und hat eine große Vision: Die erste ganzheitliche Schlafmarke der Welt aufzubauen.

Mit der erfolgreichen Marke schlafgut im Rücken und einer umfangreichen Expertise im Whitelabel-Business für große Handelsketten wollen wir nun den nächsten Schritt gehen, den Schlaf nicht nur zu optimieren, sondern zu verwandeln und zu einem echten Erlebnis für unsere Kunden zu machen. Möchtest du deinen Teil dazu beitragen, die Zukunft des Schlafes aktiv mitzugestalten?

title: Electrical Engineer (Tooling)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - N3XT (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The Embedded Engineer brings N3XT’s hardware to life. You write firmware for sensor front-ends, payload controllers, power systems and communication modules, bring up new boards with the hardware engineers, and build the low-level interfaces the application software depends on.

Prototypes in N3XT move fast. A board designed a few weeks ago lands on your bench, runs your firmware the same day and is on the test field by the end of the week. You sit between hardware and software and keep both sides honest about timing, power and interfaces.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop firmware in C and C++ for microcontrollers and SoCs (e.g. STM32, NXP i.MX, Xilinx Zynq), bare-metal or on an RTOS.

  • Bring up new boards together with the hardware engineers: drivers, peripherals, debugging with JTAG, oscilloscope and logic analyser.

  • Implement communication interfaces and protocols: CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, USB and radio links.

  • Integrate embedded Linux on compute modules: bootloader, kernel configuration, device tree and drivers.

  • Write real-time firmware for sensor acquisition and control, with attention to timing, power and reliability.

  • Define and document the interfaces to the application software and to the autopilot.

  • Support field tests and diagnose problems directly on the hardware.

  • Document firmware and interfaces for handover to line engineering.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics or a related field.

  • At least three years of embedded software development on systems that shipped or were used in the field.

  • Experience in at least one of our domains: Air, Land, Sea or Software.

  • Strong C and C++ for resource-constrained systems; experience with an RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr.

  • Hands-on board bring-up and hardware debugging; fluent reading of schematics and datasheets.

  • Embedded Linux experience with Yocto, Buildroot or a comparable build system.

  • Version control, code review and automated testing for firmware.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Business-fluent English. German is a strong advantage.

You’ll see us on campus at:

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Committed to diversity

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Geef richting aan de toekomst van high-tech elektronica.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële systemen tot geavanceerde semicon-oplossingen: onze Electrical Engineers staan aan de basis van technologie die wereldwijd wordt toegepast. Ben jij de leider die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, kennis en technische excellence? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Als Electrical Engineering Manager beweeg jij je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt je je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar ook op de technische uitdagingen van morgen. Je stimuleert kennisontwikkeling, versterkt engineering excellence en helpt richting te geven aan de verdere groei van Electrical Engineering binnen Benchmark.

Je geeft leiding aan een team van circa 40 engineers en speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste technische disciplines binnen Benchmark. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, groei en prestaties van de organisatie en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers kunnen excelleren, innoveren en zich blijven ontwikkelen.

Met jouw visie op leiderschap, talentontwikkeling en technologie bouw je aan een sterke engineeringcultuur waarin vakmanschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze Electrical Engineering-organisatie klaar blijft voor de complexe technologische vraagstukken van onze klanten én de ambities van de toekomst.

Jij combineert technisch leiderschap, people management en strategische ontwikkeling. Daarom ben jij verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van circa 40 Electrical Engineers.

  • Het leiden van de AI-transformatie binnen Electrical Engineering.

  • Het neerzetten van een duidelijke visie op Electrical Engineering en het vertalen hiervan naar de praktijk.

  • Het stimuleren van innovatie, kennisontwikkeling en technische excellentie binnen het vakgebied.

  • Het ontwikkelen van competenties, groeipaden en vakmanschap binnen jouw team.

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit, capaciteit en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Het ondersteunen en adviseren van Program Managers bij complexe ontwikkelprojecten.

  • Het aantrekken, selecteren en ontwikkelen van technisch talent.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking met internationale engineering teams binnen Benchmark.

  • Het bijdragen aan organisatie brede besluitvorming als onderdeel van het Competence Management Team en aan een lerende organisatie waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en continue verbetering centraal staan.

Samen met de managers van Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de totale engineeringorganisatie. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit andere disciplines, waaronder HR. Omdat het aantrekken en ontwikkelen van talent in deze schaarse arbeidsmarkt essentieel is, beschik je over een sterk professioneel netwerk en weet je talent aan je team en organisatie te verbinden.

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt de unieke kans om invloed uit te oefenen op zowel de technische richting als de ontwikkeling van een grote groep professionals. Je werkt in een omgeving waar complexe technologie, internationale samenwerking en persoonlijke groei samenkomen.

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij de verantwoordelijkheden en het potentieel binnen de rol.

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Je combineert flexibiliteit met een sterke interesse in technologie, bent van nature nieuwsgierig en floreert in een agile omgeving. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Daarnaast zien wij graag:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in electrical engineering en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

Seriously you?

We zoeken mensen die energie krijgen van complexe technologie en niet terugdeinzen voor een stevige uitdaging. Mensen die verantwoordelijkheid pakken, ideeën delen en samen willen blijven verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan praten we graag verder.

Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Nienke Bloemendaal via

Ben je geïnteresseerd geraakt in het werken bij een snelgroeiende en internationaal opererende high-tech organisatie? Solliciteer direct!

Een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) is standaard onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Aan het zonder opdracht, vanuit HR, voorstellen van kandidaten kunnen geen rechten c.q. verplichtingen worden ontleend.

descriptionHtml:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte Suite à une croissance rapide et rentable en France, Doctrine s'est développée en Italie et en Allemagne, puis a racheté Maïté, une legaltech espagnole, au début de l'année 2026. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un·e Engineering Manager pour continuer à améliorer notre IA juridique sur le marché espagnol. C’est un rôle stratégique qui impactera la roadmap produit et les futurs succès de Doctrine en Espagne. À noter : le poste est basé à Paris, dans nos bureaux du 18e arrondissement. Tu trouveras le détail de notre stack technique sur Github ! Bon à savoir : une expérience professionnelle préalable dans le domaine juridique n'est pas requise. En revanche, l'envie de t'investir et de monter en compétence sur la compréhension de documents juridiques est essentielle.
Les missions 🛠
  • Manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire (software engineers, data engineers, machines learning engineers).
  • Motiver ton équipe, l’accompagner dans sa performance, aider tes collaborateurs dans le développement de leurs soft skills (communication, leadership) et les accompagner dans leur évolution de carrière.
  • Être garant du suivi des projets de la squad pour délivrer dans les délais et au bon niveau de qualité.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les autres engineering managers de Doctrine
  • Challenger les décisions techniques, aider les membres de l’équipe à grandir techniquement, accompagner l’équipe dans l’atteinte de ses objectifs, notamment en les aidant à débloquer des situations techniques
  • Construire et maintenir un haut niveau de compréhension des problématiques métiers des membres de ton équipe, au service de ta crédibilité technique au quotidien

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Une première expérience réussie en management d’équipe software ou data
  • Une solide expérience en tant que que senior software engineer (fullstack developer idéalement)
  • Un intérêt marqué pour l’humain, la bienveillance et le leadership
  • Une capacité à partager tes connaissances et tirer tes collègues vers le haut
  • Une bonne maitrise de la langue française
  • Une volonté le temps que l’équipe grandisse d’être “hands on” et de contribuer au code
  • Idéalement, des notions d’espagnol car tu seras amené à manager un équipe qui travaille sur des données en Espagne

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

In this role as an Enterprise Account Executive at UiPath, you’ll be a dedicated sales specialist for the Manufacturing and Supply Chain Vertical Solutions, a world-class, enterprise-grade Agentic AI offering.


Our AI platform optimizes inventory and pricing for global industry leaders including Nike, Heidelberg Materials and PepsiCo. With a core belief that businesses need their own AI — built for their business, with their data — UiPath's pre-built AI solutions can be configured to fit unique requirements.


This position will be a hybrid role across new business logo acquisition and existing account expansion with a portfolio of accounts, working with our International GTM team.


You will be responsible for generating pipeline and executing towards a net ARR sales target. You will identify, establish and develop relationships with new and existing customers whilst working as part of a close commercial team to deliver the professionalism, consultation, and innovation that our Customers expect.
