title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing regional Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team that accelerates enterprise customer adoption by turning high-impact automation use cases into production-ready workflows. You'll own technical delivery quality, team development, and regional execution, while staying hands-on and empowering customers to become independent, successful builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

Build & Lead a High-Performing FDE Team

  • Hire, onboard, and coach Forward Deployed Engineers across your region, partnering closely with Deployment Strategists to deliver high-impact customer engagements.

  • Set and maintain a high technical quality bar for production workflows, custom nodes, integration architectures, and customer-facing delivery.

  • Manage regional team capacity, workload, and staffing while staying hands-on with customer engagements and supporting your team's technical development.

Own Regional Delivery & Customer Outcomes

  • Lead regional engagement intake and prioritization with Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships, focusing resources on high-value accounts, strategic adoption opportunities, and at-risk renewals.

  • Qualify and scope customer engagements, selecting the right mix of internal FDEs and delivery partners while ensuring clear success criteria, technical ownership, and timelines.

  • Drive measurable customer outcomes through production-ready workflows, increased adoption, and seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers, while reporting regional results and expansion signals to leadership.

Enable Customers & Scale Technical Excellence

  • Champion a customer-first delivery approach where customers build alongside FDEs, develop technical confidence, and become capable of maintaining and scaling their own automations.

  • Create and continuously improve reusable technical assets, including workflow templates, reference architectures, workshop materials, and hackathon playbooks.

  • Capture learnings from customer engagements and turn them into scalable best practices that improve delivery quality and consistency across the global FDE team.

Drive Partner Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with regional partner managers and the Partner Delivery Manager to ensure partner-led engagements meet n8n's technical and delivery standards.

  • Support partner technical readiness, certification, and quality reviews to build a reliable regional ecosystem of delivery resources.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback, integration gaps, feature requests, and custom node needs into actionable priorities, balancing reusable product improvements with customer-specific solutions.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical Customer-Facing Experience: You have 6+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, or technical consulting within a software company.

  • 🌟 Technical Leadership: You have 2+ years of experience leading and coaching technical teams, with a track record of developing talent and raising the bar for customer-facing technical delivery.

  • ⚡ Automation & Integration Expertise: You have hands-on experience with workflow automation, integration platforms, or low-code tools and can confidently design and troubleshoot complex automation solutions.

  • 🏗️ Enterprise Technical Delivery: You're experienced in building production-ready workflows and integrations, with a strong understanding of APIs, authentication, data handling, security, and enterprise architecture considerations.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional Collaboration: You're comfortable working across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Partnerships to align priorities, manage expectations, and make thoughtful trade-offs.

  • 🎯 Customer Outcome Mindset: You know how to balance technical excellence with business impact, identify high-value use cases, and empower customers to become self-sufficient rather than dependent on ongoing services.

  • 🚀 Player-Coach Mentality: You enjoy staying close to the technology and customer challenges while building a high-performing team, creating repeatable processes, and scaling delivery in a fast-moving environment.

  • 🌍 Regional Availability: You're based in the relevant region (EMEA or North America) and comfortable traveling to customer sites when needed.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 n8n Expertise: You're familiar with n8n or similar workflow automation and low-code platforms, ideally with experience building complex production workflows.

  • 🤝 Partner Ecosystems: You have experience working with systems integrators, technical consulting partners, or external delivery teams to deliver enterprise customer engagements.

  • 🌱 0-to-1 Team Building: You've helped establish or scale a regional technical delivery team, including hiring, defining processes, and building a strong team culture from the ground up.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape a regional Forward Deployed Engineering team at a pivotal moment in our enterprise growth journey. You won't just lead engineers — you'll help define how we deliver technical excellence, accelerate customer adoption, and turn ambitious automation ideas into real business outcomes.

You'll combine hands-on technical work with people leadership, working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to influence how we scale customer delivery across your region. Your work will directly contribute to getting more workflows into production, helping customers become independent builders, and creating scalable technical practices that benefit our global FDE organization.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups and a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

About the Position

Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.

At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.

You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.

Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.

About you

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems
  • Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems
  • Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains
  • Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks
  • Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework
  • Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things
  • Fluent in English

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of the team. Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités :

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.
  • Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.
  • Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.
  • Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.
  • Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.
  • Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.
  • Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.
  • Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.
  2. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.
  3. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.
  4. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.
  5. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.
  6. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.
  7. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.
  • Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.
  • Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.
  • Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.
  • Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.
  • Une certification d’architecture cloud.
  • Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Architecture Case  (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Marketing Operations
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

    • Run the Marketing-to-Sales handoff with clear acceptance criteria and feedback loops

  • Campaign, event and partner marketing operations

    • Administer HubSpot Marketing Hub and its integrations with ad, event and enrichment tools

    • Operationalize field and growth marketing: event lead capture, ABM programs, nurture workflows and partner campaigns

    • Own campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • AI, automation, and marketing innovation

    • Identify, test and roll out AI tools and automations that measurably improve marketing performance, scalability and efficiency.

    • Build workflows connecting intent signals, enrichment, CRM, landing pages and advertising platforms, to power ABM and personalized campaigns at scale, in partnership with Demand Generation.

    • Experiment with emerging GTM technologies and turn successful prototypes into repeatable marketing processes.

  • Attribution and performance

    • Own campaigns and marketing attribution frameworks and pipeline source reporting.

    • Build and maintain marketing funnel dashboard, in terms of volume, stage conversion, velocity and campaign ROI.

    • Analyze marketing funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.

  • Data quality and business partnership

    • Set and enforce marketing data standards: hygiene, enrichment, deduplication and consent management

What success looks like in 12 months:

  • Every inbound lead and target account reaches the right owner within an agreed SLA

  • Field and Demand Gen spend measurably less time on admin because they can rely on an efficient system from lead to SQL

  • Leadership can see which campaigns, events and partners touched and created pipeline

  • Marketing data completeness and accuracy support leadership decision making

  • AI-powered workflows run in production across ABM and lifecycle marketing, with measurable gains in efficiency or performance

You're a great fit if you:

What you can look forward to:

Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. What we're after

title: Network Engineer – Ground Station Networking & Integration
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The challenge

Our operators rely on a ground network that carries telemetry, video and control between drones, antennas and stations, often set up in minutes on unfamiliar terrain. Networking is what turns separate radios, computers and antennas into one system that behaves the same way on every unit. You will configure and debug on the bench, automate deployments, and troubleshoot live links during field trials.

Missions

  • Design the ground network: addressing, routing, switching and power over Ethernet between stations and antenna systems.

  • Integrate telemetry and video flows: MAVLink routing, video streams, latency and reliability measurements.

  • Connect the antenna positioning system to the station: control interface, automatic and manual modes.

  • Automate provisioning: reference images, router configurations, scripts and checklists so every unit is identical.

  • Secure and track deployed systems: workstation hardening, inventory and versions per serial number.

Required skills

  • Degree in networking, computer or embedded engineering, with experience in network deployment or embedded systems.

  • Strong IP networking fundamentals: addressing, VLANs, UDP and multicast, latency and packet-loss diagnostics.

  • Tools: Wireshark, router and switch configuration, Windows and Linux, scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash), Git, Router OS.

  • Clear documentation and cybersecurity basics for sensitive environments.

  • Autonomous and field-oriented, available for frequent travel.

How you will contribute to our success:

  • Identify and prospect new partnerships with resellers, system integrators, and consultancies with established access to public sector accounts across DACH.

  • Develop relationships with key stakeholders in potential partner organizations and maintain ongoing communication to ensure successful partnerships.

  • Navigate and support partners through public procurement processes (tenders, framework agreements, RFPs) to maximize joint pipeline conversion.

  • Continuously monitor and analyze partnership performance, identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to maximize results.

  • Negotiate and close partnership agreements with potential partners, ensuring terms are favorable to both parties and compliant with public sector procurement requirements.

  • Manage existing partnerships, ensuring ongoing communication and effective collaboration to drive growth and value for both parties.

  • Stay up to date with public sector industry trends, regulatory developments (e.g., cybersecurity compliance mandates, NIS2), competitive landscapes, and market conditions to identify new opportunities.

What sets you apart:

  • At least 3 years of experience in partner management or business development, with a focus on the DACH public sector (federal, state, municipal, or education).

  • Proven track record of acquiring and developing successful partnerships with public-sector-facing resellers, SIs, or consultancies.

  • Familiarity with public procurement processes and frameworks (tenders, RFPs, framework agreements) in Germany, Austria, and/or Switzerland.

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including within long, multi-stakeholder public sector sales cycles.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Fluent in German and English, or with additional languages such as Spanish, French and Dutch being a plus.

  • Working knowledge of AI tools, capabilities, and limitations, with the ability to translate them into practical partner and customer value.

We look for individuals who embody these core attributes:

  • Growth Mindset: Takes full ownership of setbacks and proactively seeks feedback as the fastest route to improvement.

  • Curiosity: Possesses an intrinsic drive to understand the business beyond their own role and challenges the status quo with evidence.

  • Operational Impact: Focuses on measurable business outcomes by ruthlessly prioritizing results and cutting through complexity.

  • Grit: Persists through genuine obstacles and ambitious goals, finding a way forward when there isn't an obvious path.

  • Clear Communicator: Delivers punchy, professional, and structured communication that always leads with the "why."

  • Respectful of Others: Demonstrates professional maturity by assuming positive intent and prioritizing constructive honesty over artificial harmony.

  • Technological Edge: Thinks in first principles to automate work and translate complex technology into scalable business solutions.

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Partnerships Lead, Northern Europe
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organisations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partnerships Lead to lead our partner sales and development team for Northern EMEA. Reporting to the Head of GTM Partnerships, Europe you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption.

This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value.

You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region, Northern Europe, aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership

  • Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance.

  • Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution.

  • Lead account mapping and joint account planning with OpenAI sellers and partner teams to identify whitespace, qualify opportunities, and prioritize the accounts and use cases with the greatest potential.

  • Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and partner delivery teams to address technical and implementation dependencies and help customers deploy, adopt, and expand AI workloads in production.

  • Create repeatable field engagement models, partner enablement, sales plays, and escalation paths that make it easier for OpenAI and partner teams to work together effectively.

  • Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. Use evidence to assess partner contribution, diagnose underperformance, and adjust investments and priorities.

  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships, commercial tradeoffs, and competing priorities with sound judgment, working across Legal, Security, Finance, and other teams as needed.

  • Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise sales, partner sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, AI, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of owning regional or segment-level business outcomes and delivering measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer growth through partners.

  • Demonstrated direct people management experience in partner sales, enterprise sales, alliances, or a related GTM function, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver.

  • Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization.

  • Technical-commercial fluency: you can understand customer use cases, translate partner needs into clear requirements, and engage product and technical teams on implementation tradeoffs.

  • Strong operational judgment and a builder mindset. You can create structure where a playbook does not yet exist, adapt as priorities change, and move quickly without sacrificing customer trust.

  • Clear communication, executive presence, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach to feedback and problem-solving.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and aligning account or territory coverage across a region.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional partner sales or co-sell business at a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience aligning sales and partner delivery organizations to support enterprise implementations and sustained production adoption.

  • Familiarity with AI platforms, modern cloud architectures, cloud marketplaces, and enterprise procurement models.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

title: People Operations Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

About the Role

We are looking for a People Operations Coordinator to manage day-to-day HR operations for employees across multiple countries.

You will work across payroll, EOR and HR vendors, onboarding and offboarding, employee records, and local employment requirements. The role currently supports approximately 15-20 countries and will expand as BJAK grows into new markets.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Manage monthly payroll operations across multiple countries, including payroll inputs, changes, deductions, validation and reconciliation.

  • Coordinate with EOR, payroll and HR service providers to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

  • Manage employee onboarding, contract changes, transfers and offboarding across different countries.

  • Maintain accurate employee records, employment documents and HR system data.

  • Manage day-to-day EOR and HR vendor operations, including employee cases, invoices, service issues and escalations.

  • Research employment requirements in new and existing markets, including payroll, statutory benefits, leave, termination and employment compliance.

  • Maintain country-specific HR documentation, processes and SOPs.

  • Identify payroll, employment or operational issues and work with internal teams and vendors to resolve them.

What You Will Need

  • 2+ years of experience in HR operations, payroll, people operations or a related role.

  • Experience supporting employees across multiple countries is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with payroll, EOR providers or international HR vendors is an advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling payroll, employee data and employment documentation.

  • Ability to research local employment requirements and turn them into clear processes and documentation.

  • Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and experience working with HR systems.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Ability to manage multiple countries, vendors and deadlines at the same time.

title: People Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.


We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a recognised leader in data and analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.


The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the culture, and what algo1 becomes.

The Role
We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on People Operations Manager to help us build and run the people side of algo1 as we grow.

This is a remote, part-time role, working approximately 3-4 hours each day, five days a week. There will be the occasional need to visit our London office to meet key colleagues. You’ll report to our Chief Operating Officer and work closely with our leadership team and hiring managers across the business.

We need someone who is equally comfortable handling the day-to-day essentials of HR administration and providing thoughtful, practical support on broader people matters. One day you might be preparing a contract, organising onboarding or updating employee records. The next, you could be helping a manager prepare for a performance review, working through a people issue or improving one of our HR processes.

You’ll ideally have worked in a startup or small, fast-growing business before, so you’ll understand that there isn’t always a playbook. You’ll know when to follow a process, when to improve one, and when to use your judgement to find a pragmatic solution.

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting things done, takes pride in the details and wants to make a meaningful contribution to a growing business.

What You’ll Own

  • People administration and employee lifecycle. Own the day-to-day people administration, including offer letters, employment contracts, employee records, documentation and changes throughout the employee lifecycle. Ensure everything is accurate, organised and up to date.

  • Hiring, onboarding and off-boarding. Coordinate the operational side of bringing people into and out of the business, ensuring contracts, checks, documentation and handovers are completed smoothly and people have a positive experience.

  • Right to work and immigration. Manage right to work checks and coordinate visa and sponsorship processes where required, maintaining accurate records and ensuring the business meets its obligations.

  • Performance and employee relations. Coordinate performance review processes, support managers with feedback and performance conversations, and help manage employee matters with appropriate documentation, follow-up and escalation.

  • HR guidance and compliance. Act as a first point of contact for everyday people questions, providing practical guidance to managers and employees. Maintain our people policies and processes, ensuring they remain appropriate and compliant as the business grows.

  • People systems and reporting. Own our HR systems and people data, maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring information is accessible, reliable and well organised.

  • Culture and people initiatives. Support employee engagement and wider people initiatives, helping to build a positive, thoughtful and high-performing working environment.

  • Process improvement and operational support. Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve how we manage people operations. Work closely with the COO on ad hoc people and operational projects as needed.

About You

Must Have

  • Relevant HR experience. You have a solid background in HR (or ‘People’) Operations, ideally in a generalist or standalone role where you’ve had broad responsibility across the employee lifecycle.

  • Confidence using HR systems, DocuSign and spreadsheets.

title: People Partner - Paris France
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: People Partner - Paris France

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle for our team in France. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices in line with French employment law across our Paris office and global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

Key Responsibilities:

What you'll do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, working time and leave (forfait jours, congés payés, RTT) and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defence for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to French labour law (Code du travail), the applicable collective bargaining agreement (convention collective), site-specific contracts and health and safety obligations, including keeping the DUERP (workplace risk assessment) up to date.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive or high-impact situations, monitor recurring issues and operational risks, and ensure that incidents are resolved at their root cause, with appropriate care for the employees involved.

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the Paris office.

  • Draft, review and interpret French employment contracts, amendments (avenants), non-compete clauses with their required financial compensation, and working time arrangements such as forfait jours for cadres.

  • Manage hiring formalities and onboarding under French law, including the DPAE, the registre unique du personnel, the initial occupational health visit (visite d’information et de prévention), and probation periods (périodes d’essai) and their renewal.

  • Support pre-litigation and litigation before the Conseil de prud’hommes, working closely with our external employment lawyers (avocats en droit social).

  • Review, update and maintain Radiant’s French people policies.Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

  • Ensure compliance with French employment legislation, collective agreements, internal policies and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with our external payroll provider on monthly payroll and DSN filings, and manage mandatory benefits, including the mutuelle and prévoyance schemes, and occupational health (médecine du travail) follow-up.

  • Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation).

Compliance

  • Help ensure compliance with French employment law and best practice across France and the wider EU, in consultation with the UK-based People team and external French employment counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet French employment law, GDPR and CNIL requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

  • Monitor headcount thresholds (11, 50 and 250 employees) and prepare Radiant for the obligations each one triggers, such as the CSE, the règlement intérieur, gender equality reporting and mandatory profit-sharing (participation).

  • Act as the main point of contact for the labour inspectorate (inspection du travail) and the occupational health service, and keep mandatory registers and workplace notices (affichages obligatoires) up to date.

Employee representation (CSE)

  • Set up the CSE once the Paris office reaches 11 employees for 12 consecutive months, including negotiating the protocole d’accord préélectoral and organising professional elections.

  • Run information and consultation processes with the CSE on reorganisations, policy changes and other matters that require it, and set up the BDESE once we reach 50 employees.

  • Build a constructive relationship with employee representatives and prepare for collective bargaining, including the mandatory annual negotiations (NAO) where union delegates are appointed.

Immigration and visas

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand across Europe, including UK–France moves, secondments and posted worker (détachement) requirements.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale, including the CSE consultation and French legal requirements that apply to any reorganisation.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process, alongside the mandatory entretiens professionnels every two years and the six-yearly summary review (état des lieux récapitulatif).

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance (insuffisance professionnelle) through fair, well-documented processes that would stand up before the Conseil de prud’hommes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role in France, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of French employment law (Code du travail, conventions collectives, CSE obligations, working time rules) and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • Hands-on experience running disciplinary and dismissal procedures, ruptures conventionnelles and CSE information and consultation processes.

  • Familiarity with French payroll (DSN), mandatory benefits and statutory reporting.

  • Fluent French and strong professional English, written and spoken.

  • A degree in HR or employment law (e.g. Master 2 RH or droit social), or equivalent experience.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate to external counsel.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters, particularly working alongside a UK headquarters, is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

 

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

title: People & Workplace Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

Davis is in a phase of strong acceleration. The team grows every month, our client base is widening and we are expanding in the US and in the Middle East. Our founders spend their days with developers, investors, partners and candidates, and every hour they lose to logistics is an hour taken from the company. Your job is to make sure that does not happen.

The role sits at the centre of the company and has two sides. On the people and workplace side, you work with our Chief of Staff and own the employee journey, our team rituals and our offices, in Paris and in the new ones we open abroad. On the executive side, you work directly with our co-founders, from their calendars to their board meetings. You are the first point of contact for the team and for everyone who walks through our door.

What you will be working on:

Own the employee journey

Owning the onboarding experience end to end, from equipment and access to the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one.

  • Handling offboarding with the same care, along with the HR admin that comes with each arrival and departure.

  • Being the first point of contact for the team's everyday questions and needs.

Build culture and community

  • Running and improving our team rituals, from team lunches and drinks to company gatherings.

  • Organising our offsites and our presence at industry events.

  • Creating moments that help people connect and celebrate progress, across offices and time zones.

  • Listening to the team and turning feedback into concrete improvements.

Shape our workplaces

  • Running our Paris office end to end, from vendors and supplies to welcoming the clients and investors who visit us.

  • Leading the opening of our new offices abroad over the coming months, from finding the right space to making it work for the team.

  • Managing workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and handling invoices and expense reports.

Support the founders

  • Owning the founders' complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics, and protecting their time for the work that moves Davis forward.

  • Preparing their key meetings with clients, investors and the board, and making sure every follow-up gets done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-growing startup.

  • You are fluent in French and in English.

  • You have warmth and empathy, and a genuine interest in helping people feel good and work better.

  • You anticipate needs before they are voiced, and once you start something, you see it through.

  • You are at ease switching from a travel booking to an office issue to a board meeting in the same morning.

  • You are rigorous with admin, and you have already handled invoices, expenses or onboarding.

  • You are very comfortable using AI, and you learn fast.

Nice to have

  • Experience opening or setting up an office, ideally abroad.

  • Experience in people operations in an international company.

  • Event organisation, from offsites and team events to trade shows.

  • Experience working directly with a CEO or founder.

  • Familiarity with modern finance and HR tools (accounting, payroll, applicant tracking).

  • An interest in real estate, architecture or AI.

Why Join Davis

  • Shape the Davis experience for every person who joins, at a moment the team grows every month.

  • Open our offices abroad, and build how Davis works across countries.

  • Work directly with the founders, in a seat that sees every part of the company.

  • Grow with the company, as the role expands with Davis.

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and a sports membership.

  • A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers, architects and real estate experts, backed by world-class VCs.

More About Davis

The Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today our team brings together technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA, architects and deep real estate expertise, and it grows every month. We are small with an extremely high bar, and we intend to keep it that way.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.
