title: Pflichtpraktikum im Bereich Tech (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind PsyCurio, ein HealthTech-Startup, das Psychotherapie mit Virtual Reality neu denkt. Wir bauen eine VR-gestützte Therapie-Infrastruktur, die Therapeut:innen im klinischen Alltag entlastet und Patient:innen Zugang zu strukturierten, wirksamen und modernen Übungen ermöglicht, etwa bei Angststörungen, Suchterkrankungen oder anderen psychischen Belastungen.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Psychotherapeutische Versorgung soll zugänglicher, messbarer und skalierbarer werden. Für Patient:innen, für Therapeut:innen und für ein Gesundheitssystem, das neue Lösungen braucht, statt nur längere Wartelisten zu verwalten.

Du arbeitest bei uns an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Psychologie, MedTech und Virtual Reality. Dabei unterstützt du uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer VR-Anwendungen, beim Testen und Optimieren unserer Software und Hardware, bei KI-Experimenten und der Evaluation neuer VR-Technologien sowie bei der Frage, wie digitale Therapie technisch zuverlässig und sinnvoll in den klinischen Alltag integriert werden kann. Du bist nicht nur dabei, sondern arbeitest aktiv an Themen mit, die für Therapeut:innen und Patient:innen einen echten Unterschied machen können.

Tasks

Je nach aktuellen Projekten unterstützt du uns unter anderem bei:

  • der Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung unserer VR-Szenarien in Unity: Du setzt kleinere Features um und behebst Bugs

  • Software Testing & QA: Du testest Szenarien, dokumentierst Bugs und führst Regressionstests durch

  • der Einrichtung und Pflege unserer VR-Hardware: Du setzt Headsets auf, installierst und aktualisierst Software und prüfst, ob alles zuverlässig läuft

  • technischer Dokumentation: Du pflegst Anleitungen, Testprotokolle und Entwicklerdokumentation, damit Wissen im Team nicht verloren geht

  • der Integration und Optimierung von 3D-Assets sowie einfachen Animationen

  • KI-Experimenten: Du evaluierst KI-Tools für 360°-Umgebungen und VR-Inhalte und baust erste Prototypen

  • Performance-Analysen: Du untersuchst Framerate, Ladezeiten und Standalone-Performance

  • Automatisierung: Du schreibst kleine Skripte für Tests und wiederkehrende Prozesse

  • technischem Support: Du reproduzierst Probleme und analysierst technische Fehler

  • Recherchen zu neuen VR-Technologien, Unity-Tools und Integrationen

  • Themen, die im Hintergrund wichtig sind und für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie einen echten Unterschied machen

Requirements

  • Du studierst Informatik, Medieninformatik, Game Development, Software Engineering oder ein vergleichbares Fach

  • Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, bei dem du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern wirklich mitarbeitest

  • Du bringst Programmiergrundlagen in mindestens einer Sprache mit, idealerweise C#

  • Softwareentwicklung, Virtual Reality, DeepTech/ DeepMind und XR findest du spannend

  • Du denkst mit, stellst gute Fragen und möchtest Dinge verstehen und verbessern

  • Struktur, Eigeninitiative und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich und du gehst Probleme lösungsorientiert an

  • Du würdest gern in einem kleinen, interdisziplinären Team aus Tech, Psychologie und Forschung arbeiten

  • Deutsch und Englisch sind für dich kein Problem, auch für technische Dokumentation

  • Du hast schon erste Erfahrungen mit VR Entwicklung gesammelt

  • Erfahrung mit Unity und C#, Meta Quest/OpenXR, Blender oder anderen 3D-Tools, Git, Python, Debugging und Softwaretests oder generativer KI/LLMs ist wünschenswert. Auch Interesse an Digital Health und Psychologie freut uns

  • Dein Lebenslauf muss nicht perfekt sein. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echtes Interesse

Benefits

Bei PsyCurio tauchst du tief in die Welt eines HealthTech-Startups ein, das Psychologie, Virtual Reality, Forschung und MedTech zusammenbringt. Du arbeitest an Themen mit direkter Relevanz für die psychotherapeutische Versorgung und bekommst Einblick in Produktentwicklung, wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und kliniknahe Anwendungen.

Das Praktikum ist unvergütet. Dafür erlebst du das rasante Tempo eines Startups, übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung und bringst deine eigenen Ideen ein. Die Wege sind kurz, der Austausch ist direkt und du sitzt nicht nur in Meetings, sondern bewegst wirklich etwas.

Du arbeitest bei uns vollständig remote und kannst das Praktikum in Vollzeit für bis zu drei Monate oder entsprechend länger in Teilzeit absolvieren. Abschluss- oder Projektarbeiten sind nach Absprache ebenfalls möglich. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, sprechen wir gern über eine weitere Zusammenarbeit, zum Beispiel als Werkstudent:in.

Klingt spannend? Dann erzähl uns, warum du Lust hast, bei PsyCurio dabei zu sein, was dich an Virtual Reality, MedTech oder digitaler Gesundheit fasziniert und wie du unser Team unterstützen kannst. Schick uns gern Links zu deinem Portfolio, deinem GitHub-Profil oder einem VR-Projekt, auf das du stolz bist.

title: Platform Engineer (C2)
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Platform Engineer

Team: Platform Engineering

Reporting to: Elinor Ni Chathain (Engineering Manager)

Location: London, Bristol or Edinburgh

Level: C2

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK. At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing? 

You’ll play a pivotal role in building and evolving our internal developer platform in order to empower our software teams. Your work will impact how our developers use cloud infrastructure, help teams to eliminate infrastructure toil, improve engineering productivity, reinforce security safeguards and constantly strive for greater cost efficiencies in operations.

  • Engineering Foundations: Engineering a scalable, reliable and developer friendly platform to promote seamless software development, deployment and operations.

  • Automation & Tooling: Develop tools to abstract the complex aspects of the platform from developers to improve developer experience and operational efficiency.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Use tools like Terraform, Helm and Crossplane to manage and automate provisioning of all cloud infrastructure and champion GitOps best practices.

  • Monitoring & Observability: Establish robust monitoring and logging foundations collaborating with the wider Site Reliability Engineering Function.

  • Security & Reliability: Incorporate security best practices, ensure compliance, and participate in the out-of-hours on-call rota to troubleshoot and prevent recurrent issues.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate upgrades and hold service providers accountable.

About You

Ideally you’ll have

  • Experience building and shipping production applications.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a curiosity to solve problems.

  • Experience using cloud platforms like AWS (preferred), Google Cloud, or Azure.

  • A strong desire to (or experience in) creating and maintaining Kubernetes clusters in production.

  • A solid foundational understanding of distributed systems.

  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code technologies.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with a requirement of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

What will happen next?

Feel free to contact a member of the to discuss the role. More info can be found in our Internal Recruitment Policy.

  • Contribute to shared standards, documentation, code review and continuous improvement.

  • Support business-critical services through the shared on-call rota.

  • Practical cloud experience in AWS, GCP, Azure or another major cloud environment.

  • Container experience, such as Kubernetes or ECS.

  • Infrastructure-as-code experience, ideally Terraform or a comparable tool.

  • Experience contributing to CI/CD and reliable software delivery.

  • Ability to take ownership of a project with support and work through ambiguity.

  • A collaborative approach to enabling application engineers and improving their experience.

  • Evidence of quality thinking across reliability, maintainability, security and operational readiness.

  • Experience participating in an on-call rota or supporting production services.


    • Added Bonus:

  • AWS experience and exposure to Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, Helm and GitHub Actions.

  • Experience with service discovery, secrets management, networking, monitoring or scripting.

  • Observability tooling such as Honeycomb, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk.

  • Pragmatic use of AI-assisted engineering tools.

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working. We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our Manchester office 2-3 days a week. (WeWork, Dalton Place, 29 John Dalton Street, M2 6WF) Please note this office is dog friendly so you might see some furry friends about! You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one. *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice Diversity Statement Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Praktikum eCommerce Marketplace & Shop Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unseres Teams, um einen ambitionierten Brand Builder bei seinem Wachstum auf Amazon, weiteren Marktplätzen und in unseren eigenen Onlineshops zu begleiten und aktiv zu unterstützen.

Epic Brands ist ein schnell wachsendes eCommerce Startup aus dem Herzen von Berlin. Wir entwickeln und vermarkten erfolgreich High Quality Produkte in den Bereichen Küche, Home & Living, Sport und Outdoor mit eigenen Brands wie KLAMER, Steinwood und Fitleap und verkaufen über unsere eigenen Onlineshops sowie Marktplätze wie Amazon, OTTO und weiteren. In bereits 26 Ländern freuen sich unsere mittlerweile über 600.000 Kunden über Produkte, die sie im Alltag und auf Reisen zuverlässig begleiten.

Um unsere ambitionierten Ziele zu realisieren, unsere Präsenz auf Amazon und weiteren Marktplätzen auszubauen und neue Produkte erfolgreich im Markt zu etablieren, suchen wir nun einen eCommerce Marketplace & Shop Manager im Praktikum, der/die bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns unsere Vision in die Realität umsetzt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du wirst Teil unseres Teams und managst zusammen mit den Gründern unsere Verkaufskanäle: Amazon, OTTO, eBay, Kaufland und weitere Marktplätze sowie die Shopify Stores unserer drei Marken
  • Du erstellst und optimierst Produktlistings und Content (Titel, Bullet Points, Bilder, A+ Content sowie Werbe- und Produktvideos) unter Zuhilfenahme der modernsten AI Tools und Workflows in Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO
  • Du testest Varianten in A/B Tests, wertest granulare Analytics aus und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte gefunden und gekauft werden
  • Du unterstützt bei der Werbung auf den Marktplätzen, z. B. Amazon Ads, analysierst KPIs wie Umsatz, Conversion und Werbekosten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab
  • Du pflegst und verbesserst unsere Shopify Stores mit klarem Fokus auf Content und Conversion: überzeugende Produktseiten, Landingpages und Aktionen, Optimierung der Customer Journey und neue Funktionen, die mehr Besucher zu Käufern machen
  • Du behältst die Account Health unserer Marktplatz Konten im Blick, klärst Fälle mit dem Seller Support und bist Ansprechpartner für Agenturen und Dienstleister
  • Du treibst den Rollout auf internationale Marktplätze voran und machst unsere Shopify Stores fit für neue Launches in weiteren EU-Ländern
  • Du launchst neue Produkte und konzipierst deren Markteintritt mit Werbekampagnen, Newslettern und weiteren Maßnahmen
  • Du verantwortest eigene Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung, z. B. den Start auf einem neuen Marktplatz

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast Interesse an eCommerce, Marktplätzen und Onlinehandel und willst verstehen, wie Produkte online erfolgreich werden
  • Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach oder bist dabei, dein Studium abzuschließen
  • Du hast eine hohe Zahlenaffinität und bist sicher in Excel bzw. Google Sheets. Erste Erfahrung im eCommerce, z. B. mit Amazon Seller Central oder Shopify, ist ein Plus
  • Du beherrschst Deutsch sehr gut und Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift
  • Du hast Zeit für ein Praktikum von 3 bis 6 Monaten vor Ort in Berlin
  • Du bringst “Hands on Mentalität” und Initiative mit, bist motiviert und denkst ergebnisorientiert
  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und kannst unabhängig arbeiten
  • Mit dir zusammenarbeiten macht Spaß!

Das bekommst du

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen und bekommst persönliches Mentoring, wenn du das möchtest
  • Du wirst ein integraler Bestandteil des Teams. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens und unsere Produkte und Kunden
  • Du lernst aus erster Hand, wie ein Unternehmen und seine Brands von Beginn an aufgebaut werden und international wachsen, und was “unter der Haube” läuft

title: Principal Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the technical authority for the end-to-end signal processing and inference chain for CoMind’s technologies: from raw optical data through to clinical measurements

  • Set the methodological direction for estimation, signal extraction and ML modelling across the team: which approaches suit which problems, how they are evaluated, and what evidence is required before a method is trusted.

  • Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering.

  • Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs

  • Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients.

  • Set the standard for how the data science function works: reproducibility, analysis and code review, experiment design, dataset governance and ground-truth definitions

  • Act as the primary technical reviewer and expert resource across the research organisation, reviewing technical reports, analysis plans and evaluation methodology, and holding the bar for methodological rigour and scientific integrity.

  • Identify and introduce new, best-practice methods from estimation, inference and measurement science in adjacent fields.

  • Act as a mentor to members of the Data Science teams and across the wider business

  • Contribute to CoMind's IP and publication strategy, authoring and reviewing technical papers, patent applications and regulatory documents.

AI is fundamental to our culture. It's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

Skills & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in data science, ML, or applied research, with a strong track record of independent technical leadership on complex, ambiguous problems

  • A career working to extract small signals from noisy, complex physiological systems, and developing and deploying physical models of those systems to support those efforts.

  • Deep expertise in physiological time-series signal processing methodologies.

  • A demonstrated ability to take algorithmic work from research concept through to production-quality, validated implementations in shipped product.

  • Designing device performance evaluation methods where no prior gold-standard exists: simulating physical systems, running sensitivity analysis, identifying failure modes, and developing signal processing solutions to address those challenges.

  • Extensive experience owning calibration and cross-instrument comparability work that involved noise models, error budgets, and evaluation of experimental data

  • Strong record of scientific output: publications, patents, or equivalent evidence of original technical contribution and domain authority

Nice to Have:

  • Background in neuroscience, neuromonitoring, or cerebrovascular physiology

  • Experience with optical signal processing - e.g. LiDAR, pulse oximetry, NIRS, laser doppler flowmetry, or related technologies

  • Experience in a regulated industry (medical devices, diagnostics, pharma, or similar), with familiarity of algorithm validation and documentation requirements for software as a medical device

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life assurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
The role

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities

Build and ship

  • Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production
  • Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation
  • Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call
  • Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction

  • Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured
  • Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit
  • Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design

  • Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity
  • Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin
  • Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works

  • Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working

  • Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes
  • Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise

AI-native engineering

  • Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace
  • Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows
  • Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release
  • Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails
  • Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders
  • Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations

  • Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating
  • Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)
  • Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores
  • Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry
  • Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building

  • Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop
  • Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills

  • Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets
  • Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value
  • Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer
  • Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person
  • Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated
Our Offer

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team.  This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
descriptionHtml:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

title: Product Commercialisation Partner
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Commercial Product Partnership Specialist to join our Commercial team in UK. In this pivotal role, you will act as the crucial link between our global Product Management organization and the regional Commercial teams.

In this role, you will become the region’s go-to Subject Matter Expert, bridging the gap between global product innovation and local market reality. Acting as a localized specialist, you will focus on two critical areas: Product Expertise and Market Intelligence. You will drive the adoption and revenue of our product suite among our merchants, ensuring our stack aligns perfectly with local needs. Simultaneously, you will be our eyes and ears on the ground, analyzing macro trends and emerging growth areas to help steer our regional roadmap.

This is a unique opportunity to build a pipeline of merchants based on product and market needs, and directly influence how we ship and position features in UK.

What you'll be doing

  • Become the Regional Product Authority: Master the Checkout.com product suite to a granular level. You will know exactly which products, features, and configurations align with local merchant needs and regulatory requirements.

  • Drive Product-Market Fit: Act as the filter and feedback loop between the local market and our global Product teams. You will ensure we are shipping the right solutions for the region and help tailor our value proposition to win local market share.

  • Own Market Intelligence: Develop a granular understanding of the macro trends shaping the [Region] payment landscape. You will identify exactly what is growing within the market and which emerging verticals or technologies are gaining traction, allowing us to capitalize on new growth vectors ahead of the competition.

  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor competitor activity and emerging trends to ensure Checkout.com remains a market leader. You will provide actionable insights to commercial leadership on where the market is heading and how we can capitalize on new growth vectors before they become mainstream.

  • Lead Product Commercialisation: Define and lead the regional Go-To-Market strategy for a targeted portfolio of Services. You will ensure the local sales force is equipped to effectively position, sell, and support these solutions to maximize merchant adoption.

  • Build Revenue & Backbook Pipeline: Proactively build and manage a pipeline of merchants who can benefit from specific products we are shipping. You will forecast and track Net Revenue (NR) impact, focusing on cross-selling chargeable products to deepen our commercial footprint.

About You

  • Experience: 6+ years of experience in Commercial Strategy, Product Management, Management Consulting, or a complex B2B Sales environment.

  • High Learning Agility: You are intellectually curious and a fast learner. You have the ability to absorb technical concepts quickly and can effectively communicate them to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Commercial Strategy: You are comfortable working with data, forecasting revenue, and building commercial pipelines. You understand how to identify cross-sell/up-sell opportunities within an existing client base.

  • Market Researcher: You have a natural ability to analyze market trends and macro-economics. You can look at a region and identify "what's next" before the competition does.

  • Cross-Functional Execution: You are comfortable actively partnering with global Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and regional Commercial stakeholders to turn market insights into deployed solutions.

  • Data-Driven: You base your decisions on data. You can look at market numbers, usage stats, and financial metrics to derive clear, actionable strategies.

  • Desirable: Experience in FinTech or Payments is a plus, but not required. We are more interested in your ability to grasp complex ecosystems than your current industry knowledge.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Product Designer - London
descriptionHtml:
As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations.

At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them.

What you'll be doing

  • Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them.

  • Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction.

  • Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship.

  • Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

  • Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with

The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

  • Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

  • Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

  • Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

  • Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

  • Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.

  • Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers.

  • Are fluent in Figma.

  • Can work within a design system and contribute to it.

Stronger still if you

  • Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces.

  • Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us.

If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match.

How we hire

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our London office, and a closing 30-minute conversation.

The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

US-Dollar von Investoren wie Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital und Lightspeed eingesammelt.

Wir wollen 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland für das KI-Zeitalter weiterbilden: mit einem Team, das den deutschen Markt kennt, und einem starken Partner im Rücken, der uns Tempo ermöglicht.

Du willst mitgestalten, wie Deutschlands Arbeitswelt im KI-Zeitalter erfolgreich wird? Dann komm zu uns.

Darum geht's

Der Arbeitsmarkt braucht KI-Kompetenz, und viele Menschen könnten sie lernen, wenn der Weg dorthin gefördert wird. Genau dort setzt du an. Als Lead Geförderte Weiterbildung baust du unser Angebot für Privatpersonen auf, die ihre Weiterbildung mit einem Bildungsgutschein der Agentur für Arbeit oder des Jobcenters finanzieren. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI- und Data-Programme AZAV-konform zugelassen sind, bei den Arbeitsagenturen überzeugen und Teilnehmende in einen echten Berufseinstieg oder Karrieresprung führen.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Produktmanagement, Qualitätsmanagement und Behördenkommunikation. Eng zusammen arbeitest du mit Learning Content Engineers, Sales, Marketing, Legal und der Geschäftsführung. Du verstehst die Logik des Fördersystems und übersetzt sie in Programme, die didaktisch überzeugen und sich wirtschaftlich tragen.

Das gestaltest du

  • Du leitest die Zulassung und Re-Zertifizierung unserer Maßnahmen nach AZAV, gemeinsam mit der fachkundigen Stelle.

  • Du entwickelst förderfähige KI- und Data-Programme, die zu Kostensätzen, Dauer und Arbeitsmarktbedarf passen.

  • Du baust und pflegst die Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen für Arbeit, Jobcentern und weiteren Förderstellen, damit unsere Maßnahmen in der Beratung bekannt sind und passend empfohlen werden.

  • Du gestaltest den Weg der Teilnehmenden von der Beratung bei der Arbeitsagentur über die Gutscheineinlösung bis zum Start und Abschluss der Maßnahme.

  • Du sorgst für saubere Prozesse bei Teilnahmedokumentation, Abrechnung mit den Kostenträgern und Nachweisen.

  • Du arbeitest mit Learning Content Engineers daran, Curricula, Prüfungen und Zertifikate an den Anforderungen der Förderung auszurichten.

  • Du arbeitest mit Sales und Marketing an Ansprache und Information für Interessent:innen, die mit Bildungsgutschein starten wollen.

  • Du verfolgst Vermittlungs- und Verbleibsquoten, Abbruchquoten, Teilnehmerfeedback und Änderungen im Förderrecht und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

  • Du führst ein kleines Team oder koordinierst Kolleg:innen und externe Partner fachlich.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, bevorzugt mit Bezug zu Bildungsmanagement, Wirtschaft oder Informatik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich geförderte Weiterbildung, idealerweise mit Kenntnis von AZAV, SGB III und dem Bildungsgutschein

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen für Arbeit, Jobcentern oder anderen Kostenträgern

  • Gutes Verständnis für KI- und Data-Themen und die Bereitschaft, dich in aktuelle Entwicklungen einzuarbeiten (Tiefe Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss.)

  • Erfahrung in Produkt-, Projekt- oder Qualitätsmanagement und im Planen und Priorisieren

  • Erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder in der Koordination von Teams und Partnern

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein sicherer Umgang mit Vorgaben, Nachweisen und Fristen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Product Manager - F/H
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu conduis les phases de Discovery de bout en bout. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent.

  • Tu pilotes la conception et la delivery. En collaboration avec les designers et les équipes techniques, tu animes le cycle de vie produit (backlog, roadmap, story mapping) avec une rigueur orientée valeur.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur.

  • Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 41.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux. Ou tu es PO confirmé avec une vraie volonté de progresser vers une posture PM complète (discovery, stratégie, pilotage d'impact).

  • Tu es à l'aise avec le pilotage de backlog, la roadmap et tu possèdes une culture data marquée. Ton orientation valeur est ton moteur au quotidien.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

  • Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

  • Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

  • Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

  • Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Zero to one. Building for millions who are already here.

Most 0-1 products start with no users and a lot of hope. Yours get built for millions of customers who use Taptap Send every month.


You own the idea, the execution and the outcome. Often, your best ideas will meet a regulator before they meet a user. If that sounds like a good puzzle, keep reading.

The job

You'll take new consumer products from a blank page to live, then own how they run once they're out.

  • Build from 0-1: shape greenfield consumer products, so the first version carries your thinking.

  • Own the execution: run the operational side of shipping end to end. The outcome is yours, and so is the credit.

  • Decide with data: make the strategic calls on what to build and when, and back each one with evidence you can point to.

  • Find a way through the rules: balance new ideas against challenging regulatory constraints, and still ship something innovative.

  • Ask why: understand the reason behind everything you ship for users, and challenge the status quo when the answer is weak.

Why you'll want it

  • A blank page with real traffic. You get the freedom of 0-1 work and an engaged audience in the millions waiting on the other side of it. Feedback arrives fast, and it's real.

  • Room to grow. Taptap Send runs lean, talent-dense teams. You own real work early and take on more as soon as you're ready.

  • Products that matter to the people using them. Remittances pay for school fees, medical bills, rent and food. They're a lifeline for millions of families and worth more than all foreign aid combined. Every product that makes sending cheaper and more reliable puts more of that money in families' hands.

Is this you?

  • You've shipped products and stuck around to own the results.

  • You make strategic calls from data, and you can explain them to anyone in the room.

  • You push back on "how it's always been done", and you always want to know why something is worth building.

  • You know how to balance regulatory constraints with innovative thinking for a best-in-class product


Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. Your CV doesn't need to be polished, just honest about what you've shipped.

title: Product Manager - Network
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

As a Network Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's networking product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the rapidly evolving networking landscape, and you understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale.

You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and networking products.

What You’ll Do

  • Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's networking offerings — including cluster networking, observability, VPCs, Direct Connect, cross/multi-cloud interconnects, private connectivity services, NAT, and IP address management to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale.

  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the network must hit.

  • Connectivity strategy and architecture: Drive the cross-DC and multi-site connectivity strategy, network topology, and failure-domain design in close partnership with engineering.

  • Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the networking product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their networking needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company.

  • Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the networking domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning.

  • Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership.

  • Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, hands on practitioner, with a strong focus on networking and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments

  • Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one.

  • Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact.

  • Strong analytical instincts with the ability to use data to inform and defend multi-year infrastructure decisions.

  • Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers.

  • Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation.

Bonus

  • Hands-on background in data center network design, including global backbone architectures, cross-DC and multi-site connectivity, and peering.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Ready to design products and services that make a difference?

Do you want to create products that make a meaningful impact? Are you ready to lead strategy and delivery on projects that reach large audiences?

As a Product Manager, you’ll lead product strategy and delivery, balancing user needs and business goals across sectors, to create services that are used by millions of UK citizens.

The role

You’ll work with technical teams and stakeholders to develop solutions that deliver our clients’ strategic goals. You'll work in agile teams alongside people in a range of roles spanning design, development, and research.

You’ll help deliver the vision, helping to decide the features that each product needs and manage backlogs to meet our client preferences. You'll deliver discovery and ideation workshops across diverse groups of stakeholders.

Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client.

This role involves weekly on-site working. Applicants should be able to travel, as part of their daily commute, to client sites in one of the following locations: Newcastle, Leeds or Manchester.

We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process.

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

We’re looking to welcome new team members for multiple roles from November onward. If you’re interested in joining Opencast, we’d encourage you to apply.

Essential consulting skills

In addition to business analysis skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:

£60,000 - £70,000 per annum.

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.

title: Product Marketing Manager - Care Providers & Health
descriptionHtml:
Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, site or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Care homes and clinics sit among our priority sectors.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on health, starting with groups that run several care homes, clinics or practices, and work out how Light wins there.

These groups carry the finance problems of any multi-entity business, plus funding models, regulation and workflows of their own. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across the sector.

You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with our Care and Health Sales Managers, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how care home groups and clinics buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

  • Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

  • Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of an operator or a finance director.

  • Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak the sector’s language.

  • Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, workflows and vocabulary of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

  • Bringing the sector’s requirements back to Product, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

  • Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

  • Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

  • A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

  • Experience in health, care or a closely related sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with operators matter more.

  • Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

  • Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a deal.

  • An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why.

  • Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever care homes and clinics do business.
🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in a sector from its first deals.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Care home groups and clinics run complex businesses on finance tools that weren’t built for them. We want to change that, and we want you to learn the sector inside out and show us how. When you apply, tell us about a segment you got to know from scratch: how you learned it, what you changed because of it, and how you helped Sales win there.

title: Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role

As Product Marketing Manager, you shape how the market understands our portfolio: positioning, differentiation and outside-in stories that turn complex legal tech into value buyers recognise, and that drive pipeline and revenue.

Scope

Product training, documentation and demo environments sit with our Enablement teams. Success means clarity in the market, consistent positioning, and GTM teams who tell our story well.

Core responsibilities

Foundational strategy

  • Develop deep market and competitive insight.
  • Update and evolve ICPs, personas and use cases.

Positioning and messaging

  • Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external.

Operational impact

  • Activate positioning across the GTM organization through launch alignment, messaging briefings and strategic field engagement.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement to embed messaging frameworks in the field.
  • Drive coherence across website, campaigns, launches and proof points.
  • Refine positioning using win/loss insights and market feedback.

AI and new ways of working

  • Design, test and run AI-assisted PMM workflows, for example call and win/loss analysis, competitive monitoring and content review.
  • Document what works so the whole Marketing team can reuse it.
  • Bring new ideas on how we work, and test them quickly.

Who you work with

  • Reports to: Senior Product Marketing Manager

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in enterprise or complex software.
  • A proven track record shaping positioning, messaging and GTM strategy, not just executing it.
  • Cross-functional experience with Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
  • Remote-first: you've built alignment across time zones without a shared office.

What really sets you apart

Strategic thinker, decisive operator: you know when to challenge and when to ship. Market-obsessed: you anticipate competitor moves and spot positioning gaps. Exceptional storyteller: you simplify complexity without diluting substance. Business-minded: you link your work to pipeline, win rates and deal velocity. Builder with AI: you've already set up a new process, agent or workflow with AI and can show what changed. Impact over output: you measure influence, not volume. Strong opinions, loosely held: you defend your view with evidence and adjust when the market proves otherwise. Problem solver with energy: you move problems forward at pace, even when they sit outside your job description. Team player with range: you work easily with Product, Sales and CS, and adapt to what the team needs this week. Out-of-the-box thinker: you question how things are done, propose new ways and test them.

Recruitment process

1.Phone screening with Talent Acquisition 2.First interview with our Senior Product Marketing Manager 3.Case study 4.Team and stakeholder interviews, including our Global Head of Marketing 5.Final interview with our CEO or another key stakeholder

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Stockbroking
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Project Director
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands.
