Gesucht wird eine Art Direktorin oder ein Art Director (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung in Vollzeit, die eigene Ideen entwickeln und sie selbst in gute Layouts umsetzen.

Das Besondere bei TEAMWFP: Jeder Kunde wird auf Senior-Level betreut. Es gibt keinen Kunden, der an Praktikanten und Junioren abgegeben wird, und keine Ebene, die zwischen dir und deiner Arbeit steht. Im Agenturverbund arbeiten rund 30 Leute. Große Meetings gibt es kaum, vieles wird kurz über den Flur abgestimmt, und die beiden Creative Directors arbeiten selbst mit am Produkt. Du gestaltest für viele verschiedene Kunden und hast abends Zeit für dein Leben, ohne jeden Tag nach Düsseldorf zu pendeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Briefings kommen über die Beratung zu dir. Du bearbeitest sie allein oder im Team, mal als reine Designaufgabe, mal konzeptionell und gestalterisch.
  • Du entwickelst visuelle, kommunikative Ideen und verdichtest sie gemeinsam mit Text und Konzept.
  • Du setzt deine Ideen selbst in gute Layouts um, egal ob Store-Design, Out-of-Home-Motiv, Mailing oder TV-Spot.
  • Später betreust du bei Bedarf auch Mediengestalter und Junioren und gestaltest die Agentur mit.

Was du mitbringst

  • Eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium in einem kreativen Beruf, etwa Mediengestaltung, GTA oder Kommunikationsdesign, oder vergleichbare Erfahrung als Art Director.
  • Erfahrung als Art Director in einer Werbe-, Kommunikations- oder Designagentur oder auf Kundenseite.
  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Photoshop, InDesign und Illustrator, dazu Interesse an KI und neuen Trends.
  • Lust, Ideen zu entwickeln und sie auch umzusetzen, und sehr gutes Deutsch.

Was dich bei TEAMWFP erwartet

  • Ein Gehalt ab 4.500 € im Monat, je nach Qualifikation nach oben offen.
  • Senior-Level auf jedem Kunden: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Leuten auf Augenhöhe, von Store-Design bis TV-Spot, jeden Tag ein anderes Medium.
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr, Überstunden werden ausgeglichen. Wochenend- und Nachtschichten gibt es nicht.
  • Ein fester, eigener Arbeitsplatz in kleinen Büros für eine bis drei Personen statt Großraum und Desk Sharing.
  • Ein Backsteinbau im Nordpark mit Aufenthaltsraum und Billardtisch, aus Gladbach auch gut mit dem Fahrrad erreichbar.

Ehrlich gesagt: Das Arbeitstempo ist etwas höher als in vielen anderen Agenturen, weil effizient gearbeitet wird und Entscheidungen schnell fallen. Wer damit klarkommt, bleibt gern und lange.

Diese Stelle wird über JobMatches vorgestellt. Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Art Director (m/w/d) bei TEAMWFP in Mönchengladbach. Nach einem kurzen Telefonat lernst du Kim Finocchiaro und beide Creative Directors persönlich kennen, danach folgt ein Probearbeitstag.

title: Senior Business Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Transportbedrijven staan voor grote veranderingen. Digitalisering, SaaS, data, integraties, automatisering en AI bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden. Maar technologie alleen lost niets op. Het begint met begrijpen hoe een klant werkt, waar processen vastlopen, welke verandering nodig is en waar werkelijk waarde kan worden toegevoegd.

Daarom zoeken wij een Senior Business Consultant Transport voor onze locatie in Hoogeveen. Iemand die niet begint met onze software, maar met de business van de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Jij doorgrondt logistieke processen, ziet kansen en krijgt organisaties in beweging.

Hoe kunnen transportorganisaties slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendiger werken? Als Senior Business Consultant Transport help jij onze klanten om die stap te zetten. Je bent een strategische gesprekspartner voor planners, key-users, IT, operations en management. Je begrijpt hun processen en uitdagingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen en slimme oplossingen.

Je kijkt verder dan de technologie alleen. Je onderzoekt wat een organisatie écht nodig heeft en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen niet alleen worden bedacht en geïmplementeerd, maar ook daadwerkelijk worden omarmd en toegepast.

Welke werkzaamheden kan je verder verwachten?

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van transport- en logistieke processen.

  • Leiden van workshops en adviseren van klanten over procesverbetering en digitalisering.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete requirements en oplossingsrichtingen.

  • Adviseren over SaaS, integraties, data, automatisering en AI.

  • Begeleiden van verandertrajecten, van analyse en advies tot implementatie en adoptie.

  • Creëren van draagvlak en meenemen van stakeholders op alle niveaus.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen en bijdragen aan demo's, offertes en businesscases.

  • Vertalen van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar nieuwe toepassingen, samen met Product Owners en de business.

  • Delen van kennis en coachen van collega-consultants.

Meer dan alleen consultancy

We zoeken geen consultant die zich uitsluitend richt op software of configuraties. We zoeken iemand die de vraag achter de vraag ontdekt, processen durft uit te dagen en klanten helpt écht stappen vooruit te zetten.

Je combineert inhoudelijke expertise met commercieel inzicht. Doordat je dicht bij de klant staat, herken je kansen voor aanvullende oplossingen en dienstverlening. Je weet deze te vertalen naar concrete meerwaarde voor de klant en onze organisatie.

Technologie én mensen in beweging brengen

Je hebt affiniteit met technologie en volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van SaaS, API's, data, automatisering en AI. Je hoeft geen developer te zijn, maar weet technologische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar praktische toepassingen.

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat succesvolle verandering begint bij mensen. Je herkent verschillende belangen, maakt weerstand bespreekbaar en weet organisaties mee te nemen in een nieuwe manier van werken. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan de go-live: het gaat om daadwerkelijk gebruik en blijvend resultaat.

Jij adviseert niet alleen hoe het beter kan, maar zorgt ervoor dat het ook écht beter wordt.

Your Mission

No deck that ends up in a drawer. No next project. Real ownership.

The global CX outsourcing market is worth more than 400 billion USD. yoummday has built a disruptive model to change this market: a technology-driven platform that combines AI automation with a global network of highly qualified freelance CX professionals. With 100 million euros in revenue, 150 customers worldwide, and a new office in Miami, we're just at the beginning of what's possible.

We're looking for you, starting now, as Senior Consultant / Manager Business Strategy M&A Focus (m/f/d) for our headquarters in Munich.

Our Business Strategy team (made up of former consultants from Bain, BCG, EY-Parthenon, and Roland Berger) in Munich and Berlin owns cross-functional, strategically critical projects end-to-end, from analysis to concept development to operational implementation within the organization.

You'll work closely with the leadership team and the Head of Strategy (ex-BCG) on the company's core strategic topics and see directly how your work creates measurable impact and drives real change in the business.

Unlike traditional consulting, your impact here doesn't end on a slide: you'll see firsthand how your analyses, decisions, and projects get implemented in the organization, and what difference they actually make.

You'll analyze existing processes, particularly in operations, identify levers for efficiency and quality, and implement concrete improvement measures.

About us

Are you looking for a profitable scale-up that offers you long-term prospects and a disruptive business model with a growth-oriented corporate culture? Do you also want to grow beyond the usual standards, bring your own initiative and appreciate actively shaping topics?

Become part of our team and set new standards in AI-supported customer service with us to create smart, data-driven solutions that inspire.

title: Senior Consultant - Senior Manager, Decision & Insight Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Data, AI, Solutions and Engineering practice are looking for experienced Senior Consultants, Managers and Senior Managers to join the team. 

Insight is changing quickly. Static dashboards and periodic reporting are increasingly being complemented by conversational analytics, embedded insight, AI-enabled applications and agents. The opportunity is not simply to produce more insight. It is to help organisations create measurable value by improving the decisions and actions that shape performance. 

We are looking for Decision & Insight Leads who can work at the intersection of business, data and technology. You will start with strategic and operational outcomes, understand the decisions and behaviours that drive them, explore the available data, and shape an insight capability that people will actually use. The answer might be a redesigned KPI framework, semantic model, dashboard, analytical application, conversational experience, agent, or a combination of these. 

This is a technically grounded analytics role, not a non-technical business analysis role. You will be comfortable analysing data and building meaningful elements of analytical solutions yourself, while also being able to frame value, shape the wider solution and lead multidisciplinary delivery. At more senior grades, your personal build time may reduce, but your judgement should remain rooted in genuine analytical and technical depth being able to architect these solutions. 

What you will be doing

  • Understand the strategic and operational outcomes a client is trying to achieve, identify the decisions and behaviours that drive them, and define how better insight can unlock measurable value. 
  • Frame ambiguous business problems as clear analytical and decision problems, connecting objectives to decision journeys, KPI/value trees, use cases, measures of success and prioritised delivery backlogs. 
  • Explore and analyse data directly to test hypotheses, understand patterns and data quality, challenge assumptions and establish what is feasible. 
  • Shape and, where appropriate, build the insight and decision architecture: what should be standardised through data and semantic models, what should be surfaced through visualisation or conversational interfaces, and where insight should be embedded directly into operational workflows. 
  • Design analytical experiences, including wireframes and human-AI interactions, that help people understand, trust and act on insight. 
  • Work in and, with experience, lead mixed teams of Baringa colleagues, client teams and technology specialists from discovery and analysis through build, deployment, adoption and value realisation. 
  • Contribute hands-on to analytical solution delivery, while providing technically informed leadership and challenge across solution design, data, analytics and AI choices. 
  • Ensure solutions are usable, trusted, governed and embedded into the way an organisation works, rather than stopping at a prototype, report or technical artefact. 
  • Build lasting client capability through coaching, pairing, knowledge transfer and reusable approaches, so clients can continue to evolve their insight capability after the engagement.  

Your skills and experience  

You might describe yourself today as an analytics consultant, technical business or data analyst, insight transformation lead, analytical product owner, BI / analytics lead, or something else entirely. Whatever your current title, you will be an analytically strong, technically grounded practitioner who knows how to turn data and technology into better business decisions. 

  • Excellent analytical and data literacy, with the ability to interrogate data yourself, structure analysis, test hypotheses and translate findings into clear business implications. 
  • Deep experience shaping, building and deploying analytical solutions into real business environments, rather than only defining requirements or managing delivery. 
  • Strong hands-on grounding in the core analytics toolkit, likely including SQL and tools such as Power BI or Tableau, together with Python or comparable modern analytical technologies. You do not need to be a specialist engineer, but you should be able to build meaningful elements of an analytical solution yourself. 
  • Strong understanding of KPI and metric design, analytical and semantic modelling, and the shared definitions and architecture needed to create trusted, reusable insight in an explainable manner to business leaders. 
  • A robust grounding in how AI is changing analytics, with hands-on experience of capabilities such as conversational analytics, generative BI, LLM-enabled insight or agents. We do not expect everyone to have deployed these technologies extensively at enterprise scale, but we do expect experimentation, practical build experience and informed judgement about where they create value.

How the opportunity flexes with experience 

At Senior Consultant level, we expect strong hands-on analytical delivery and growing ownership of workstreams, solution design and client relationships. At Manager level, the emphasis grows toward shaping solutions, leading mixed teams and owning delivery and value outcomes while retaining meaningful technical involvement. At Senior Manager level, we expect leadership of complex, ambiguous client problems, senior relationships, proposition and market contribution, and the technical credibility to define an insight architecture, set direction and bring the right specialists together.  

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

title: Senior Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

We're a small data team with a big job: helping everyone at Cosuno make better decisions. Our data platform is stable and in good hands. What we need now is someone who takes our most important, open-ended business questions and answers them properly: in depth, with little guidance, and often before anyone thought to ask.

You'll work across product and commercial topics. How do general contractors and subcontractors actually use our platform? What makes some accounts grow into company-wide rollouts? Which levers move our funnel the most? You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success and leadership, and we expect you to have opinions.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Work out what drives account growth: which behaviours predict long-term retention and expansion, and how Sales and Customer Success can act on them.

  • Map how our customers really use the product: which workflows stick, where new features find their audience, and what healthy adoption looks like in an account's first months.

  • Pick a question nobody has asked yet, answer it, and change a product or go-to-market decision with the result.

  • Build the dbt models and Looker views your analyses need, so the next person can answer the question themselves.

How we work

  • Questions Over Tickets: You don't wait for requests. You figure out what matters and go after it.

  • Depth Over Dashboards: One analysis that changes a decision beats ten reports nobody reads.

  • Pragmatic by Default: Simple processes, fast iterations, and the lightest method that gives a trustworthy answer.

  • Clarity Wins: A finding is only as good as how well others understand it and act on it.

  • AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools and expect everyone to use them fluently.

Your profile

  • 5+ years in analytics at fast-growing startups or scaleups, ideally B2B SaaS, where your work shaped product or commercial decisions.

  • An exceptional ability to reason through ambiguous business problems: framing the right question, choosing a sound approach, and landing on a clear recommendation.

  • Hands-on experience in both product analytics (usage, adoption, engagement, experimentation) and commercial analytics (retention, expansion, funnel, pricing).

  • A track record of driving your own analytical agenda with minimal guidance.

  • Strong SQL and professional experience with dbt and a BI tool (a strong command of Looker is a big plus). You build the models and views you need instead of waiting for them.

  • Solid Python for analysis and scripting.

  • Strong, hands-on familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude Code, and a habit of using them in your daily work.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. You can explain a complex finding in one clear paragraph.

Bonus

  • Experience with marketplaces or two-sided platforms.

  • Experience in vertical SaaS, construction tech or procurement.

  • Experience with BigQuery.

 

Compensation: €80K – €100K

Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.

Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience. We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.

Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.

Context

We are seeking a senior systems thinker to anchor the data lifecycle of Outsight's spatial events. This individual will own the structural flow of high-volume event data processing from our internal Perception stack and 3rd-party datasets, translating them into well-modeled, hyper-performant warehouse layers and clean semantic models.

Agentic Workflow & Productivity Edge: You must possess deep familiarity with structuring semantic layers specifically to be accurately browsed and mapped by LLM-driven agents. The ideal candidate actively utilizes advanced AI coding frameworks to multi-thread feature delivery and automate pipeline unit testing, achieving an outsized development cadence.

Why join us?

Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.

As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.

Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.

Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

title: Senior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the Role.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join Zilch’s Risk team, with a focus on developing and optimising advanced models in the Risk space, primarily across credit risk, with additional focus on collections optimisation and fraud detection. You will leverage diverse data sources to support key areas across the business, building production-grade models and decisioning solutions that improve risk outcomes, customer experience, and operational efficiency. This role will involve close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, risk strategy, credit, collections, fraud, and other data scientists, to ensure data-driven insights are successfully integrated into product strategies, risk decisioning, and business growth initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong applied machine learning with modern ML Ops practices. We are looking for a data scientist who can take models from exploration through to production, monitoring, and iteration.

Key Responsibilities.

  • Work with large and complex datasets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using various analytical and statistical approaches.

  • Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to develop strategies for our products that serve millions of customers and thousands of merchants.

  • Build, validate, deploy, and monitor robust, scalable machine learning models and model pipelines across the risk lifecycle, including onboarding, affordability, life-time value, credit/default risk, in-life risk, collections, and fraud.

  • Present complex data science findings and methodologies to senior stakeholders clearly and concisely.

  • Apply machine learning methods to solve risk and product-related business problems and enhance our decision-making processes.

  • Contribute to the team’s coding efforts, ensuring best practices in version control, testing, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, methodologies, workflows, and tooling.

  • Conduct A/B testing, champion/challenger testing, and experimental analyses to evaluate new features, risk strategies, model changes, and product changes.

  • Partner closely with engineering and platform teams to operationalise models, automate workflows, and improve model reliability in production.

What We're Looking For.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data scientist, with a focus on building and deploying models to enhance the customer product experience, risk decisioning, and business outcomes, ideally within credit risk, collections, fraud, financial services, lending, payments, or another decision-intensive domain.

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python and core data science and machine learning libraries, such as NumPy, Pandas and Scikit-Learn.

  • Strong practical experience with machine learning model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production environments, including cloud-based model training, archiving, serving, endpoint deployment, and tools such as Amazon SageMaker or similar.

  • Experience communicating complex ideas to non-technical audiences and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning methods, their application in real-world scenarios and a keen awareness of their limitations.

  • A strong engineering mindset, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-ready code, use version control systems such as Git, and collaborate effectively in a multi-developer environment.

  • A results-driven approach, with the ability to quickly iterate and improve models in production.

  • Knowledge of AI safety considerations, such as bias detection, privacy management, and handling personally identifiable information (PII).

  • Familiarity with software development best practices and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, such as GitHub Actions.

  • Experience using DBT for data modelling and Looker for BI reporting.

  • An interest in staying up to date with evolving technologies and applying them to enhance business outcomes.

Nice to Have.

The following are bonuses rather than strict requirements. We do not expect candidates to have all of them:

  • Familiarity with risk model governance, explainability, fairness, affordability, or regulatory considerations in financial services.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING

We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Cloud & Platform Engineering
    • Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
    • Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
    • Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
    • Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud Security 
    • Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
    • Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
    • Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
  • Technology leader
    • Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult’s global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
    • Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to  infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
    • Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
  • Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
  • Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
  • Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
  • Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
  • Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In 6 months time…

By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult’s infrastructure.

  • Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
  • Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
  • Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
  • Have a full understanding of Catapult’s products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.

In 12 months time…

By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult’s technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.

  • End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
  • Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
  • Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
  • Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: Senior Director, International Development
descriptionHtml:
Thank you for considering Oklo. We are hiring a Senior Director, International Affairs to join our Strategy team.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Senior Director of International Affairs to develop international opportunities that can materially advance the company's long-term strategy. This role connects market choices, senior relationships, sovereign and government capital, industrial partnerships, and selected cross-border initiatives.

You will help determine where Oklo should engage, which institutions matter, and what a credible partnership or investment proposition should look like. The scope extends across the company's businesses and strategic priorities, rather than being limited to individual international reactor deployment projects.

You will report to the Chief of Strategy Officer and work directly with the CSO on assigned initiatives. You will coordinate closely with the CFO organization, Government Affairs, Legal, technical and regulatory leaders, and business-unit teams, with explicit agreement on market coverage, counterpart relationships, and execution responsibilities.

This person must reside in either the United Kingdom or the Netherlands. 

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Target markets and partnerships. Develop recommendations on priority markets, institutions, and opportunities based on strategic fit, partner capabilities, commercial demand, capital availability, timing, and risk.
  • Sovereign and institutional relationships. Build and advance relationships with sovereign investors, government institutions, industrial partners, and other organizations relevant to Oklo's global strategy.
  • Structure international opportunities. Develop business cases and proposed structures for international partnerships, sovereign or government-capital opportunities, joint ventures, and other cross-border initiatives.
  • Advance transactions. Work with Finance, Business Development, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, and Legal to test economics, assess counterparties, develop terms, and advance approved opportunities toward executable agreements.
  • Navigate regulatory and policy dependencies. Coordinate with Government Affairs and technical, regulatory, and legal specialists on political, policy, licensing, export, and other dependencies that affect an opportunity's feasibility.
  • Lead initiative execution. Lead assigned initiatives across internal teams and outside advisers, maintaining clear objectives, owners, milestones, and decisions through launch or handoff.
  • Prepare and represent leadership. Prepare senior leadership for important international engagements and represent Oklo when delegated; work with the Strategy Associate on research, analysis, and materials and the Strategy Manager on coordinated follow-through.
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders. Align engagement plans with existing international and business-unit owners, avoid conflicting commitments, and recommend where to advance, defer, or decline an opportunity.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience in international business, strategic investing, government, industrial partnerships, or a related field, with evidence of delivering outcomes across institutions and jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop substantive relationships with senior government, commercial, or financial counterparties and translate engagement into concrete opportunities
  • Strong commercial and financial judgment, including the ability to evaluate partnership economics, business cases, and potential capital structures.
  • Experience leading cross-functional work while drawing on appropriate technical, legal, policy, and financial expertise.
  • Excellent writing and cross-cultural communication, sound discretion, and the ability to make practical recommendations from incomplete information.
  • Must reside in the UK or the Netherlands.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with sovereign investors, development finance, government-backed capital, or cross-border industrial ventures.
  • Exposure to nuclear energy, the fuel cycle, infrastructure, advanced technology, or other strategically important industries.
  • Experience connecting government and commercial objectives; relevant regional expertise or additional language capabilities.

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Director, International Affairs that is:

  • Able to connect geopolitical and institutional context to specific commercial choices
  • Able to build durable trust while maintaining clear objectives and realistic commitments
  • Able to work effectively across cultures, disciplines, and organizations with different incentives
  • Can distinguish meaningful strategic progress from access, visibility, or meeting volume
  • Passionate about clean energy 
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Highly strategic and a forward-looking thinker
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity
  • An exceptional communicator, negotiator, and has relationship-building skills
  • Contains a strong executive presence and cross-functional leadership ability
  • Aware of global perspectives with awareness of geopolitical and macroeconomic trends
  • Passionate for building transformational infrastructure businesses
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways 
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally 

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $250,000-$290,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through  to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

title: (Senior) Electromagnetic Simulation Engineer (Magnetics & RF) (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

We’re looking for a hands-on (Senior) Electromagnetic Development Engineer to support the development of our systems across magnetic and RF domains and other simulations, e.g. of thermal effects. In this role, you will combine simulation, lab validation, and engineering feedback to improve product performance from prototype to deployment. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify electromagnetic issues early, validate concepts in the lab, and translate findings into practical design improvements.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Develop and run electromagnetic simulations for magnetic and RF systems in industrial machines

  • Analyze and optimize components and system behavior, including coils, shielding, antennas, cabling, and subsystem interactions

  • Investigate electromagnetic effects on machines and assemblies during integration, testing, and operation

  • Identify and mitigate EMI/EMC, coupling, and interference issues across electrical and mechanical interfaces

  • Translate findings into concrete design improvements and provide feedback to electrical, mechanical, and system engineering

  • Support product development from design through integration, validation, and certification readiness

 

What is expected of you

  • Strong background in electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

  • Several years of hands-on experience in electromagnetic simulation and development in an industrial environment on system level

  • Good understanding of electromagnetic theory and simulation methods such as FEM, FDTD

  • Power user of simulation tools like Ansys HFSS, Maxwell, Icepak or similar

  • Practical experience with measurement, testing, and validation of electromagnetic behavior on real systems

  • Familiarity with EMI/EMC requirements

  • Experience with development processes related to CE, SEMI, UL or IEC 61010 compliance is a strong plus

  • Ability to derive pragmatic engineering solutions and work effectively across disciplines

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: (Senior) Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Our flight-control system is already flying Skyron400. Now we want to make it faster, sharper and more capable.

As our Senior Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer, you will take technical ownership of the control and estimation capabilities that determine how precisely our interceptor estimates its state, how quickly it reacts and how aggressively it can operate without compromising stability or robustness.

From advanced estimation and control algorithms to embedded Rust optimization and flight-test analysis, you will set technical direction, make decisions based on real flight data and drive measurable improvements in aircraft performance.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of flight-control and state-estimation architecture, priorities and validation.

  • Improve state estimation using Kalman filters, IIM, particle filters and model based approaches.

  • Fuse IMU, radar, camera and ToF data into robust vehicle and target-state estimates.

  • Increase the accuracy of velocity and position estimation in GPS-denied environments.

  • Optimize sensor filtering, synchronization, outlier rejection and latency compensation.

  • Own the design, implementation and tuning of flight-control algorithms for maximum agility, precision and stability.

  • Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers.

  • Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments.

  • Profile and optimize flight-critical Rust code for deterministic execution and minimum latency.

  • Plan and lead flight-test analysis, identify performance limits and turn every flight into the next improvement.


What You Bring to the Team

This is a senior flight-control role. We are looking for deep expertise in flight-control design and tuning, together with a strong understanding of how control, state estimation, sensing and embedded implementation interact as one complete system.

  • At least four years of professional experience developing and tuning flight-control systems, including implementation and testing on real systems. Experience with drones or other UAVs is strongly preferred.

  • Exceptional candidates coming directly from university may be considered only if they can demonstrate at least three years of substantial hands-on flight-control experience through projects, research programs, student teams or comparable work, including implementation and testing on real systems.

  • Deep foundations in control theory, state estimation, sensor fusion and flight dynamics.

  • Hands-on experience with Kalman filters, nonlinear estimation or probabilistic filtering.

  • A proven track record of designing, tuning and validating controllers for highly dynamic systems.

  • Strong implementation skills in Rust, C++ or another systems programming language.

  • A strong understanding of real-time execution, numerical stability, sensor timing and latency.

  • Hands-on experience with simulation, system identification, flight-log analysis and flight testing.

  • The drive to challenge existing performance limits, test ideas quickly and keep iterating until the data proves the improvement.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Join Quantum-Systems?

  • Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Database Observability, Grafana Cloud | UK | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

About Grafana Cloud Observability

Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.

The squad: Database Observability

We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

The opportunity:

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
  • Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
  • Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
  • Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
  • Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
  • User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.
  • You care about our community of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.

Bonus Points for 

  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.
  • Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.
  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £94,000 - £118,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. title: Senior Implementation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, then choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

 

The Software Implementation Engineer is a hands-on technical delivery role at the centre of complex NHS deployments. At Heidi, the CSM owns the customer from day one: the relationship, the rollout plan, the path to renewal. The Implementation Engineer is the technical arm they lean on: the person who personally configures SSO with the customer's IT team, sets up and provisions tenants, delivers EHR integrations through to go-live, configures agents and custom builds, and gives every technical problem a fast diagnosis and the right owner — fixing what is configuration, and handing confirmed product defects to Support Engineering, who own and drive their resolution.

You are the reason launches don't stall on technical topics. The remit is deliberately broad: anything to do with getting an account set up, configured and optimised is yours, from account configuration and MFA through to integration build and iteration, rather than being split across several specialist roles.

Clinical training and adoption sit with Clinical Enablement, not here. Your ownership begins upon acceptance of the enterprise handover. It ends when the agreed technical scope has passed its acceptance criteria, customer sign-off has been recorded, the final configuration has been documented and the implementation has transferred into hypercare or BAU support.

You are technically credible in front of a CIO, precise in what you hand to engineers, and relentless about closing the loop — and you translate what customers need technically into clear, prioritised asks for the Technical Program Manager (TPM), who owns the integration roadmap and prioritisation.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Hands-on delivery — you personally set up, configure and validate the technical footprint of an account: identity, provisioning, integrations, agents, data flows. Not coordinated — done.

  • Technical ownership — every technical problem at your accounts gets a fast diagnosis and a clear owner. What is configuration or implementation, you fix; what is a product defect, Support Engineering owns and drives — you hand it over with the diagnosis attached and do not shadow the ticket. CSMs never have to diagnose or route technical problems themselves.

  • Fast unblocking — technical blockers that would stall a launch for weeks get diagnosed, sequenced and resolved in days, because you understand the problem and know exactly who has to do what.

  • Clean boundaries — you hand net-new build work to FDEs as precise, prioritised requirements they can act on without rework, and you route live product defects to Support Engineering with a proper diagnosis attached — you don’t hoard work that belongs elsewhere, and you don’t toss problems over walls.

  • Trusted translation — customer IT and security teams treat you as a peer; the Technical Program Manager (TPM) gets integration gaps and technical priorities from you they can act on, and product hears a clear, prioritised signal.

This is a delivery-accountable role, so your job is to make the technical side of every account work: identity live, tenants configured, integrations delivered, agents built, security questions answered, and technical problems solved before they become escalations.

What you’ll do

Technical Onboarding & Account Setup

  • Own the technical setup of new enterprise accounts end to end: tenant and workspace configuration, user provisioning and seat structure, environment readiness.

  • Configure SSO with the customer’s IT team — SAML / OIDC against Okta, Microsoft Entra and NHS identity infrastructure — including MFA and conditional-access alignment.

  • Drive network and device readiness: whitelisting, VDI and shared-device constraints, mobile device management, so clinicians can actually use Heidi on day one. Work directly with customer IT to clear whatever is blocking a swift deployment: deployment questionnaires, IT vetting, access requests, environment prerequisites.

Integration Delivery

  • Receive the validated integration design and signed SOW from presales. Confirm implementation prerequisites, elaborate the agreed design where necessary, configure the Heidi components, perform technical testing, support customer UAT and execute the technical go-live activities within the implementation plan you own.

  • Translate the agreed SOW and technical design into precise, prioritised implementation requirements; hand net-new build to FDEs in a form they can act on without rework, own the account-side delivery around it, and surface integration gaps to the Technical Program Manager. Raise any requirement that is missing, materially different or genuinely out of scope through formal change control before work proceeds, rather than absorbing scope creep silently.

  • Provide credible estimates, identify dependencies early and give the CSM evidence-based status and recovery options. You own the integrated technical plan, customer-facing delivery dates and dependency escalation. After go-live, keep working with the trust integration team to iterate and optimise the integration: anything that is not a product defect is yours to make work.

Product-technical Configuration

  • Set up agentic workflows, agents and custom builds to fit each account’s clinical and operational workflows, turning vague customer asks into scoped configurations with clear acceptance criteria.

  • Translate what the customer bought into what has to be configured, and set it up: products, identity, integrations, agents, APIs, exports and data flows. As Heidi adds products (agents, agentic workflows, comms), their account-level setup lands here too.

  • Handle technical template and coding setup where it crosses into system behaviour (clinical content stays with Clinical Enablement).

Technical Escalation & Resolution

  • During active implementation and hypercare, be the first technical port of call for CSMs: when something technical breaks or will not configure, you provide first-line diagnosis and make sure it lands with the right owner. Once an account has formally handed over to BAU, Support Engineering owns initial triage and ongoing incident management, and you are re-engaged only through agreed escalation criteria.

  • Diagnose before you route: implementation-phase and account-specific configuration issues are yours to fix; confirmed product defects go to Support Engineering with your diagnosis attached — they own and drive resolution, and Support Engineering owns defect resolution. The Implementation Engineer remains informed where the defect affects implementation milestones, acceptance criteria or customer readiness, without duplicating Support’s investigation.

  • Translate customer technical problems into clear priorities — routing integration gaps to the Technical Program Manager (who owns the roadmap) and confirmed defects to Support Engineering — the alignment that gets problems actually solved.

Information Governance & Security Enablement

  • Provide accurate technical input and evidence for DPIAs, security questionnaires and IT-assurance requests, routed through Compliance, who owns these processes. Security, Privacy and Clinical Safety retain approval authority for their respective positions. Keep them off the critical path without becoming the sign-off owner.

  • Work within NHS governance gates — clinical safety sign-off, IG approval, change-control windows — planning technical work around them (clinical-safety substance is owned by Heidi’s Clinical Safety Officer).

Handover acceptance and scope control

  • Review the signed SOW, discovery notes, technical decision record, architecture, acceptance criteria, success measures and open risk log before technical implementation begins.

  • Return the handover where a blocking material risk, unclear scope or unsupported commitment prevents a credible implementation plan.

  • Deliver against the agreed scope without converting new customer requirements into configuration work.

  • Classify emerging requests as in-scope configuration, defect, net-new engineering, roadmap request or commercial change.

  • Escalate material scope changes through the CSM, SE and AE before committing work or dates.

 

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

Our Benefits

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You'll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Your health, covered. Comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, plus 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder and a £100/month Healthy Heidi’s stipend.

  • Global parental leave. 26 weeks paid for primary carers and 18 weeks for secondary carers, subject to eligibility.

  • Fertility support. £7,000 one-off payment, eligibility applies.

  • Learning & development. £700 per year for courses, books, memberships, conferences and more.

  • Home office budget of £500 one-off to set up a workspace you actually want to work in.

  • Recharge days after major milestones and busy periods so you can reset and come back strong.

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, wherever the world takes you.

  • Clinical leave. 10 days per year for eligible clinical roles to maintain accreditation and requirements.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.
