title: Senior Manager, Engagement
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Professional Services is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced leader to run Legora's Professional Services team, building and developing the people who own our most significant professional services relationships, and setting the standard for how those firms adopt Legora and change the way they work.

This is a role for someone who has led teams through change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed, not hoped for. You will own the performance of the team and the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers: hiring and developing Engagement Managers, setting the adoption strategy they execute against, governing quality and pace, and stepping in at the senior moments that decide whether a programme lands.

That portfolio includes our global relationship with one key Big 4 client, our most significant professional services partnership, delivered by the Engagement Managers in your team across its member firms. You will set the direction for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, hold the programme to account, and be the senior Legora voice in the room when it matters. You will travel when needed to support your team in market and build relationships at the most senior level.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption capability at Legora: designing the playbook the team works from, helping our clients realise measurable ROI, and scaling a function that can carry far more than it does today.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the Professional Services team and own the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers. Specifically, you will:

  • Lead, hire and develop the Professional Services team: set expectations, coach Engagement Managers, run performance and development conversations, and build a bench that can scale with the business.

  • Own the global adoption strategy for the portfolio, including our flagship Big 4 relationship, and hold the team accountable for coherent execution across regions and member firms.

  • Define the adoption playbook the team works from: the change-management approach, stakeholder mapping, operating cadence and target outcomes that make our programmes repeatable rather than heroic.

  • Govern delivery quality and pace: success plans, enablement, value reviews, escalation paths, and intervene where a programme is off track.

  • Act as the senior Legora relationship owner for the most important stakeholders in the portfolio, stepping in at executive moments, QBRs and escalations while your team runs the day-to-day programme.

  • Be accountable for adoption, retention and satisfaction across the portfolio, with clear measurable outcomes and ROI you can defend to clients and internally.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional engagement to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end context across the portfolio.

  • Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.

  • Travel internationally to support your team on the ground and build senior relationships across member firms.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You get satisfaction from making a team better than it was when you found it, and you're comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change.

We're looking for:

  • 8+ years' professional services experience - management consulting, legal, LegalTech or enterprise customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.

  • At least 5 years in a people management role, with a track record of hiring, developing and retaining high-performing teams.

  • Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable — we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms.

  • A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations.

  • Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes — and then making that approach repeatable across a team.

  • A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong cross-functional influence: much of what your team needs sits with Product, Engineering and GTM, and you can bring those people with you without direct authority.

  • Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries, or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.

  • Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident.

  • Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams.

  • High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise, when to act and when to let your team run.

  • A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.

  • Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Manager of Global Communications
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager of Global Communications

The Senior Manager of Global Communications will lead Quince's media strategy and external storytelling as the company enters its next stage of growth. This is a rare build: the sole owner of the communications function, reporting directly to the Head of Brand Strategy & Narrative, with the mandate to shape how the market understands Quince's manufacturer-to-consumer model. The ideal candidate is a proven media operator with 8+ years of experience and genuine, current UK journalist relationships — someone who can translate complex operational ideas into stories that build trust over time, not just generate coverage.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute Quince's UK communications strategy, building brand reputation and relevance as we scale in the market
  • Own UK media relationships, building deep ties across national, consumer, fashion, lifestyle, retail, business, and tech press
  • Drive a steady stream of proactive earned media, with culturally relevant UK story angles rather than imported US messaging
  • Lead communications around key UK moments (launches, campaigns, milestones), spotting opportunities beyond the announcement itself
  • Stay plugged into UK cultural and media conversations, and act as an early-warning system for reputation risk
  • Write and edit at an exceptional standard across pitches, press materials, and executive briefings, and prepare spokespeople for UK media
  • Partner closely with Brand, Social, Growth, Merchandising, and Creative to build communications into launches from the start, and manage UK agency partners
  • Build rigorous earned-media measurement (coverage quality, sentiment, share of voice) and the systems/playbooks to scale UK comms over time

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in communications, public relations or media strategy, with significant experience working in the UK market
  • Deep, current relationships across UK national, consumer, fashion, lifestyle, retail and/or business media, and a strong understanding of how the UK media ecosystem actually works
  • Experience building the reputation of a consumer brand, retailer or high-growth company; experience supporting a new market entrant or rapidly scaling brand is a plus
  • Excellent editorial judgment and a strong instinct for what constitutes a genuinely compelling UK story
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to move comfortably between consumer storytelling, corporate narratives and sensitive reputation communications
  • Strong understanding of UK culture, consumer sentiment and the nuances that distinguish UK communications from US communications

title: Senior Mendix Developer
descriptionHtml:
Je kunt uitstekend bouwen. Maar bepaal jij ook de koers?

Er zijn genoeg developers die Mendix beheersen. De vraag is of jij degene bent die de architectuur neerzet, een businessanalist uitdaagt op haalbaarheid, en daarna de developer naast je meeneemt in de realisatie. Dat is een ander niveau. En precies wat wij zoeken.

De uitdaging

Klanten als Defensie, LPMW en DGC bellen niet voor een simpele CRUD-applicatie. Ze komen met vraagstukken waarbij schaal, integratie en technische complexiteit van nature botsen met tijdsdruk en ambitie. Jij bent de senior die daarin navigeert. In de praktijk betekent dat: native B2B apps bouwen, custom widgets ontwikkelen voor complexe visualisaties zoals Gantt Charts, Java actions schrijven en architectuurkeuzes verdedigen die over meerdere sprints standhouden.

Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en werkt op opdracht bij klanten. Die combinatie geeft je technische diepgang én breedte: of het nu gaat om verkeersdoorstroming verbeteren of waterkwaliteit monitoren, jouw werk heeft tastbare impact. Af en toe schuif je aan bij presales of een haalbaarheidsanalyse. Niet als verplicht onderdeel, maar omdat jouw technisch oordeel de klantgesprekken beter maakt.

Je plek: de Mendix squad

De Mendix squad werkt vanuit wederzijds vertrouwen en een cultuur waarbij verbeteringen worden aangemoedigd, niet afgewacht. Als senior heb je ruimte om anderen te mentoren en je visie op architectuur daadwerkelijk door te voeren, niet alleen te adviseren.

Elke twee weken komen alle Explorers (onze werknemers) op vrijdag samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern: de clubdag. Tot 10% van je werktijd investeren we in leren, kennisdeling en verbinden. Zo kan je de clubdag gebruiken om te experimenteren met de Process module, de Audit tool en widgetontwikkeling, of werken aan zaken als een resource planner of PWA offline-functionaliteit. Niet omdat het moet, maar omdat de ruimte er is.

Lees hier meer over de Mendix squad.

  • Beheersing van Nederlands en Engels op professioneel niveau.

  • Oog voor UX en performanceoptimalisatie.

title: Senior ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world

SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival.

We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies.


The Role

You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will:

  • Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most
  • Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one
  • Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks
  • Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust
  • Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning
  • Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven

What We're Looking For
  • Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on
  • Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool
  • Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it
  • Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you
  • Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision
  • Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits
  • Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience
  • Language: English. German is a plus for shop-floor conversations.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at Zurich, Switzerland, with regular time on the shop floor at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany.

What we're not looking for
  • Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped
  • Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship
  • Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs
  • Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these

What we offer
  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the free world. What your systems learn in Factory ONE, every next factory applies.
  • The Environment: A real factory as your lab, with direct access to the people who run it, and ownership of the core of SAEKI's value proposition from day one.
  • The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ

Apply
  • Resume: Focus on systems you shipped that real users relied on, and what happened to them after launch.
  • Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

title: Senior MLOps Engineer - Edge
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer for our Hardware Group to build and scale the machine learning infrastructure that powers Focus, our line of smart cameras. You'll own the edge deployment pipelines that transport neural networks from training clusters to tens of thousands of devices globally, and contribute to the platform that compiles trained models into optimised inference engines for devices like the Jetson Orin, building the "nervous system" for the next generation of automated sports capture.

As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you'll:

  • Build scalable Edge infrastructure. You'll design, develop, and maintain the delivery systems that enable us to deploy models to fleets of devices.
  • Own the model compilation platform. You'll build and maintain the pipeline that takes trained models and produces optimised, hardware-specific inference engines — managing TensorRT compilation, precision trade-offs (FP16/INT8), calibration, and engine validation to ensure models run reliably and efficiently on target devices.
  • Work with cross-functional teams. You'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Embedded Engineers, and Product Managers to ensure smooth integration of complex features and capabilities
  • Drive automation and reliability. You'll implement infrastructure to silently test candidate models on production devices and build telemetry pipelines to monitor drift, thermal impact, and inference latency in the wild.
  • Solve complex physical challenges. You'll tackle the unique constraints of the edge - building resilient update mechanisms for low-bandwidth environments, optimising for limited storage, and ensuring devices recover gracefully from network failures.
  • Mentor and lead. You'll share your expertise to establish best practices in Python tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD, guiding the team toward a more robust, automated future.

Location

We'd like to hire someone for this role who lives near our offices in London or Barcelona, but we're also open to remote candidates in the UK and Spain.

Must-Haves

  • Production MLOps expertise. You've played a key role in building and operating pipelines that deploy models to production, with deep experience in CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and Linux systems.
  • Collaborative. You understand that shipping to hardware is a team sport and can communicate effectively with researchers and low-level embedded engineers to translate constraints into solutions.
  • Systems thinking. You can design architectures that handle failure gracefully and understand the implications of deploying to 10,000 heterogeneous devices, including how to manage risk via canary releases and safe rollbacks.
  • Bias towards action. You see your role as solving problems; this means filling gaps and taking initiative as needed to help the team win together.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Edge inference & compilation know-how. You have hands-on experience compiling and optimising models for embedded hardware - ideally with TensorRT - and understand the practical implications of precision, quantisation, and engine validation at scale.
  • Experience with our Edge AI stack. Experience with the NVIDIA edge ecosystem (Jetson Orin, DeepStream SDK, TensorRT) is a huge plus.
  • Video Technologies. Familiarity with video pipelines, GStreamer, or ffmpeg.
  • Fleet management. Experience with tools like AWS IoT Greengrass, Balena, or custom OTA / fleet management solutions.
  • Sports Passion. You have an interest in sports technology, video analytics, or performance metrics—but if not, we'll teach you the domain.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

title: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.

You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.

This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.

You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.
  • Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.
  • Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.
  • Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.
  • Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.
  • Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.
  • Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.
  • Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.
  • Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.
  • Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.
  • Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.
  • Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.

What we’re looking for

  • Around six or more years of hands on and strategic experience in performance marketing and media buying.
  • Strong experience managing paid social and video channels, ideally including TikTok, YouTube and Meta.
  • Experience owning campaigns from initial idea and creative brief through implementation, optimisation and measurement.
  • A track record of managing six figure budgets and delivering efficient performance.
  • Experience working with MMM, incrementality testing or other measurement methods beyond traditional attribution.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign performance, conversion funnels, CAC and LTV.
  • A strong understanding of digital measurement, from tagging and attribution through to incrementality.
  • Experience developing creative and UGC assets for paid social channels.
  • The ability to balance creative thinking with strong commercial judgement.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to figure things out. When you do not know the answer, you know how to find it, whether that means speaking to the right person, digging into documentation or using AI tools.
  • Confidence working across teams and influencing partners in Creative, Product Marketing, Data and Finance.
  • Comfort operating with uncertainty. You are happy testing ideas, learning from the results and changing direction when the data tells you to.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in SaaS or B2B lead generation.
  • Experience across sales technology or marketing technology.
  • Experience managing external agencies or digital production partners.
  • Experience with ad servers and campaign trafficking.

title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions.

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability.

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration.

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation.

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture.

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software.

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability.

Bring-up, Commissioning and Validation

  • Plan and execute payload bring-up and commissioning on vehicle prototypes and demonstrators: mechanical fitment, electrical integration, software provisioning (flashing, configuration, diagnostics), troubleshooting, and validation up to full system commissioning where the complete E/E system is proven to work.

  • Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing.

  • Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams.

  • Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation

  • Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations.

  • Actively support build-ups, rework, payload installation, and vehicle-level commissioning in the workshop during prototype and customer-specific integration phases.


What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines.

  • Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication buses (CAN, ideally CAN-FD or automotive Ethernet), including reading and debugging bus traffic during integration.

  • Solid mechanical integration understanding: mounting concepts, packaging, tolerances, vibration, environmental robustness, accessibility, and serviceability.

  • Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. You are comfortable automating recurring integration tests.

  • Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups.

  • Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Hands-on mentality: comfortable working directly on vehicles, prototypes, harnesses, brackets, and payload installations in the workshop.

  • Strong communication skills across engineering teams, suppliers, procurement, and program stakeholders.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment.

Your Benefits:

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

descriptionHtml:

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. 

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities 
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers. 
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager

Own the complex product challenges behind the next generation of MedTech software.

REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

Now we're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to take ownership of some of the most important and complex areas of our AI-native platform.

The role

This is a role for someone who loves product craft, enjoys solving difficult problems and wants substantial ownership over what gets built.

You'll work closely with customers, engineers, designers and our founders to turn complex enterprise workflows into AI-native product experiences.

You'll own the full product development cycle within your area:

Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning.

You'll be responsible not just for defining what to build, but for making good decisions, driving execution and ensuring the result actually solves the problem.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real product ownership. We don't expect you to manage other PMs, but we do expect you to lead through your judgment, technical understanding and ability to get things done.

What you'll do

  • Own complex product areas end to end: Take responsibility for discovery, prioritization, definition, delivery and continuous improvement within your domain.

  • Stay close to customers: Work directly with enterprise users to understand their workflows, identify the problems worth solving and distinguish real needs from feature requests.

  • Build AI-native product experiences: Help translate complex, regulated processes into products that make practical use of AI agents and automation.

  • Work deeply with Engineering: Collaborate on technical approaches, APIs, data, AI systems, integrations and trade-offs to find solutions that are both valuable and feasible.

  • Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, making clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

  • Drive products from idea to production: Turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, work closely with Engineering and Design, and take ownership of getting solutions shipped.

  • Learn from what you ship: Define what success looks like, evaluate product adoption and customer outcomes, and use those insights to improve the product.

  • Work in an AI-native way: Use AI deeply in your own work and continuously explore how it can improve discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development.

What we're looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have substantial hands-on experience managing B2B enterprise software products.

  • Have personally owned complex product areas, taking them from discovery through development, launch and iteration.

  • Have strong product judgment and can independently identify priorities, evaluate trade-offs and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Are deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, and working closely with Engineering.

  • Are genuinely AI-forward: you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

  • Are comfortable discussing technical architecture, APIs, data, integrations and complex workflows with engineers.

  • Know how to balance individual customer needs with building a scalable product.

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have built products from 0→1, particularly in an early-stage environment.

  • Have experience developing and shipping AI-powered or agentic products.

  • Have worked on complex enterprise workflows, technical platforms or products in regulated industries.

  • Have been a founding PM or an early product hire and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

  • Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

  • Have experienced both early product development and the challenges of scaling an established product.

Why REMATIQ?

  • A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product capabilities for our next stage are still being defined and built.

  • Real product ownership: You'll own meaningful product problems from discovery to delivery, with the authority to make decisions and directly influence what gets built.

  • AI is the product and the way we work: You'll work on practical AI applications in complex enterprise environments and help rethink how products should be developed in an AI-native company.

  • Complex problems worth solving: Our customers operate in environments where workflows are technical, regulated and mission-critical. The product challenges are correspondingly deep.

  • Work directly with the people shaping the company: Collaborate closely with our founders, Engineering and Design, with a direct connection between customer problems, product decisions and shipped outcomes.

  • Meaningful impact: Better software can help medical innovators reduce manual work, navigate complexity and bring important products to market faster and more safely.

You will lead commercial relationships with key gift card providers, define the product roadmap, and partner with engineering and design to scale gift cards into an integrated core offering across web, app, and browser extensions.

  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

title: Senior Product Manager, Trust & Safety, Integrity and Fraud
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

About the Team

Our Trust & Safety, Integrity and Fraud Product team is dedicated to ensuring a safe and trusted experience for all customers across our platform, including Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. We tackle complex challenges, from preventing fraud, abuse and Account Takeover to ensuring authenticity, to building regulatory compliance capabilities, all while balancing risk mitigation and providing a seamless user experience. Our team partners closely with cross-functional groups, including Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Risk Operations, to drive strategic initiatives that protect our business while fostering growth.

About the Role

Trust is foundational to an on-demand marketplace. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are converging European capabilities into one platform and one global product capability to prevent fraud and abuse. The marketplace is expanding rapidly beyond just restaurants as we become “your door to more." As we add new products, geographies, ways for Consumers, Merchants and Couriers to engage, we’re expanding and enhancing our fraud capabilities to be best in the industry at keeping our platform safe and trustworthy. We strongly believe that trust is the most important attribute of an online marketplace, and the team ensures that we maintain this trust.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager that will lead dedicated cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges that impact Consumers, Couriers and Merchants and touch every corner of our business - from new user onboarding, to the in-app delivery experience, to the products and services being created that our users can’t find anywhere else. We are looking to hire for a few roles, so you’ll either lead a vertical fraud team protecting Consumers, Couriers or Merchants, or lead a horizontal fraud platform team focused on building our Risk Engine, Data Signals Intelligence and Automation / Anomaly Detection capabilities or leading compliance and authenticity efforts involving Identity Verification and Right to Work. The Fraud team is in hyper growth in terms of its size and impact and offers a unique opportunity to set and execute on a vision that will shape the future of Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt globally.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Set the vision and long-term product strategy for one of our vertical fraud teams or our horizontal platform fraud team.

  • Prevent, detect and mitigate fraud and abuse, building and leveraging AI systems to address risk in real time.

  • Build an AI-led fraud operations platform that turns complex marketplace signals into automated decisions, prioritised investigations, and actionable case workflows, stopping fraud, abuse and manipulation before incidents occur.

  • Develop and execute a customer-focused product roadmap through close collaboration with senior leadership, Operations, Data Science, Analytics, Design, and Engineering all while balancing business needs.

  • Translate customer and internal-user needs into clear, well-defined functional and technical requirements backed by data analysis and deep understanding of our users

  • Guide and interface closely with data analysis and engineering teams to define scope, review and refine technical capabilities, prioritize projects for release, and define new opportunities.

  • Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities for product performance, tracking, and to create product insights.

  • Establish business cases and projected return on investment to identify and prioritize opportunities

  • Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to manage the impact on the profitability of the overall business.

  • Establish success metrics and executive reviews covering fraud trends and P&L impact.

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-functional products from strategy through execution in ambiguous problem spaces.

  • Experience defining strategic vision and roadmap execution in a given product area.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-enabled or automation-heavy products, with sound judgment about where models can accelerate decisions and where human expertise, safeguards, and accountability must remain central.

  • Experience in technology, fraud, privacy, security, data governance, trust & safety, risk or an enthusiasm to learn and keep customers and the ecosystem fraud-free and protected

  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous policy, legal, or regulatory requirements into practical, scalable product solutions and clear engineering priorities.

  • Fluency in modern AI product development, including evaluating model quality, designing human-in-the-loop experiences, and translating emerging capabilities into practical, measurable customer and business value.

  • Extreme customer centricity with a focus on ensuring low-friction experiences for good customers.

  • An analytical, structured approach to ambiguity and risk, with the ability to frame tradeoffs, define controls, and set measurable outcomes.

  • Experience partnering effectively with Legal, Compliance, Public Policy, Security, Privacy, Operations, Data Science, Design, and Engineering.

  • An interest in applying AI and data-driven systems to improve fraud detection, triage, escalation, and prevention, with sound judgment about safeguards and human oversight.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior leaders around urgent, high-stakes decisions.

  • Direct experience applying AI/ML to prevent, prevent, detect and mitigate harm, plus AI fluency — you can build a feature with AI – not just write PRDs.Why Join Us?

 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale

Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast

Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership

Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders

High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create

Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 

Our Global Structure

title: Senior Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel.

Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt.

De uitdaging

Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken.

Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof.

Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet.

Jouw plek

Bij LINKIT werken we in squads, dit zijn onze expertise teams. Elke twee weken is er de clubdag: alle Explorers komen op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor kennissessies, verdieping en verbinding. Tot 10% van je werktijd gaat naar leren en groeien, niet als bijzaak maar als onderdeel van hoe LINKIT werkt.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Aantoonbare Agile/Scrum ervaring; SAFe is een sterke pré.

  • PSPO I en PSPO II certificering (aanvullende certificeringen zijn een pré).

  • Ervaring binnen enterprise-organisaties, overheid of infra-omgevingen.

  • Affiniteit met data-intensieve omgevingen en begrip van architectuur, integraties, migraties, security en compliance op hoofdlijnen.

  • Afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

  • Professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €6.000-€7.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten,, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  1. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  1. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Siënna via

Over LINKIT

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing.

Als Senior Product Owner werk je op opdracht bij onze klanten, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.  

Rethink it with LINKIT.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and trustworthy products across AlphaSense's AI-native platform. You'll work closely with architects, engineering, and product teams to embed security by design throughout the software development lifecycle.

This role sits at the intersection of AI/ML security, secure architecture, threat modeling, and customer-facing assurance — defining the standards, automation, and frameworks that enable secure, intelligent products at scale.

What You’ll Do:

AI Security & Enablement (30%)

  • Architect and enforce security controls for AI/ML systems — model training, data pipelines, inference environments, and agentic workflows.
  • Identify and mitigate AI-specific attack vectors: prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion, model theft.
  • Implement model provenance, integrity, and auditability controls for responsible, secure AI operations.
  • Align AI security with governance and compliance teams against frameworks like NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act.

Secure Architecture & Development Lifecycle (30%)

  • Embed security throughout the software and AI development lifecycle, partnering with architects, engineering, and product across AlphaSense's application and cloud ecosystems.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance by design.
  • Define and maintain secure development standards, guidance, and best practices.

Threat Modeling & Security Review (20%)

  • Lead threat modeling, secure design reviews, and risk assessments across the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and maintain security automation and governance that integrates into development workflows.

Customer-Facing Security Assurance (10%)

  • Produce customer-facing security assurance — security questionnaire responses, security whitepapers, and trust collateral — that unblocks enterprise deals.
  • Represent product security in customer, cross-functional, and leadership discussions.

Leadership (10%)

  • Mentor teams on secure coding, AI risk management, and secure design.
  • Promote a security-first culture through advocacy, documentation, and training.

What We Are Looking For: 

  • 5–7+ years in product, application, or cloud security engineering.
  • Deep understanding of secure SDLC, threat modeling, and secure architecture design.
  • Ability to read and review code to inform threat models and design reviews.
  • Experience securing AI/ML pipelines, data workflows, and model-serving infrastructure, with working knowledge of AI/LLM security (prompt injection, model integrity, provenance).
  • Proven expertise with cloud security concepts and best practices across multi-cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps and CI/CD environments.
  • Familiarity with encryption fundamentals — symmetric and asymmetric cryptography, TLS/mTLS, key management, and secrets handling.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization patterns in modern applications: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, RBAC, and ABAC.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional security initiatives — partnering with engineering, product, and compliance to embed security into roadmaps, influence architectural decisions, and align stakeholders across boundaries.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency in Python, Java, and/or JavaScript for security automation and tooling.
  • Container and orchestration security (Kubernetes runtime protection).
  • Software supply chain security and artifact integrity verification.
  • Experience with bug bounty programs — triaging findings, driving root-cause analysis, and turning results into systemic security improvements.
  • Familiarity with compliance and governance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, NIST AI RMF).
  • Certifications such as CKS, CISSP, CSSLP, or AI/ML security credentials.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge security challenges in a fast-growing company.
  • Opportunity to shape and drive product security strategy.
  • Collaborative and security-minded engineering culture.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range£90,000—£122,000 GBP

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

title: Senior Programme Manager
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Senior Programme Manager at Mews, you’ll run several high-visibility programmes that cut across departments, working alongside senior leaders on their hardest problems and taking responsibility for turning their decisions into changes people use in their day-to-day work. This is a new role, so you’ll help set how projects are run here instead of stepping into an existing way of working. Mews is a global hospitality technology company, so the scope is wide and the pace is fast.

You’ll partner with department leads and senior stakeholders across the business. Most of the people you deliver through won’t report to you, so the work depends on clear plans, clear decisions and the trust of the teams involved.

Programmes that cross departments tend to fail in familiar places: dependencies nobody owns, a status that reads green until it suddenly doesn’t, and changes that are delivered but never adopted. This role exists so initiatives land on time, in scope and in a way that shows up in how people work.

What you would do

  • Run strategic, cross-departmental initiatives end to end, from roadmap and scope through to delivery and adoption
  • Build project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies and decisions, and deliver on time and in scope
  • Manage several complex projects at once and keep priorities clear across them
  • Present project data to senior stakeholders, flag risks early, and run the communication that gets a change adopted, then measure whether it was
  • Use AI to draft plans, status updates and risk logs, set the checks they pass before reaching stakeholders, and share templates other project managers can reuse

AI Fluency Level 3: In this role that means you have changed how project work gets done with AI, such as how plans, status and risks are captured and reported across several projects, beyond saving yourself time. You have built templates or workflows that other project managers or teams now use. And you check what the AI gives you against the underlying dates, owners and data, question summaries that look too clean, and apply stricter checks when the audience is senior leadership.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • Extensive experience managing complex, cross-functional projects, ideally in SaaS or another fast-growth environment
  • A track record of building and running project plans, managing stakeholder expectations and delivering business results
  • Experience working with executive leadership across departments, and excellent written and spoken English
  • Good judgement with project data, the ability to visualise and explain it, and working knowledge of project management tools and frameworks
  • AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you have redesigned how projects are run with AI, built approaches others follow, and verify what it gives you

Nice to have

  • Experience in hospitality technology
  • Change management experience, including communication and stakeholder engagement plans
  • Experience contributing to project management standards, templates or a PMO
UK£64,000—£77,000 GBPUnited States $101,000—$129,000 USD

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
FASTR Energy gehört zu den führenden Energiedienstleistern und Stromversorgern in Deutschland. Das Unternehmen wurde 1989 in Aachen gegründet und hat heute seinen Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf sowie Niederlassungen in Berlin, Hamburg, München und Leipzig. Aus einem ursprünglich familiengeführten Unternehmen ist ein dynamischer Energiepartner geworden, der sich im Mai 2025 durch die Partnerschaft mit KKR auf einen klaren Wachstumskurs begeben hat. In einer spannenden Transformationsphase gestalten wir aktiv die Zukunft der Energieversorgung – mit einer klaren Vision: Als Dekarbonisierungspartner der Immobilienwirtschaft leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende in Deutschland. Im Contracting betreiben wir aktuell rund 1.000 Wärmeanlagen – bis 2030 sollen es über 5.000 werden.

Aufgaben

Als (Senior) Projektrealisierer (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die operative Umsetzung von Bau-, Modernisierungs- und Dekarbonisierungsprojekten im Bereich Wärmeversorgung – mit Schwerpunkt auf Erneuerbaren Energien. Du bist nah an der Baustelle, steuerst Subunternehmer und externe Dienstleister und sorgst dafür, dass aus geplanten Projekten funktionierende Anlagen werden. Dabei berichtest Du an den Teamleiter Realisierung. Neben unserem Standort in Düsseldorf suchen wir auch für Hamburg, Berlin und München.

Projektumsetzung

  • Von der Übergabe aus der Projektentwicklung bis zur mängelfreien Abnahme steuerst Du Bau-, Modernisierungs- und Dekarbonisierungsprojekte – z. B. Wärmepumpen, Retrofit- und Hybridlösungen – in time, in budget, in quality.

  • Leistungsverzeichnisse und technische Zeichnungen erstellst und pflegst Du und bringst dich in die Optimierung von Anlagen und Abläufen ein.

Baustelle & externe Partner

  • Subunternehmer, Generalunternehmer und externe Dienstleister wählst Du mit aus, beauftragst, steuerst und bewertest sie – inklusive Prüfung von Angeboten, Nachträgen und Abnahmen.

  • Bei Baustellenbegehungen behältst Du Termine, Kosten, Qualität und Arbeitssicherheit im Blick und steuerst bei Abweichungen das Eskalationsmanagement.

Reporting & Schnittstellen

  • Projektfortschritt, Kosten und Risiken dokumentierst Du und berichtest regelmäßig an den Teamleiter Realisierung.

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit Projektentwicklung und Betriebsführung zusammen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Übergang vom Bau in den Betrieb

Qualifikationen

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Energie-, Gebäude-, Versorgungs- oder Bauingenieurwesen) oder ein Meister- bzw. Technikerabschluss mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung bildet deine Basis.

  • Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Umsetzung technischer Bau- oder Energieprojekte, idealerweise in der Wärmeversorgung, bringst Du mit – Erfahrung mit Contracting, der Steuerung von Subunternehmern und der VOB ist ein Plus.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, kennst relevante Normen und Arbeitssicherheitsstandards und gehst sicher mit MS Office um; CAD- und PM-Tool-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und lösungsorientiert, packst mit an, trittst gegenüber Partnern durchsetzungsstark auf und bist bundesweit reisebereit.

  • Du kommst aus einer anderen Branche? Bewirb dich gerne – entscheidend ist deine Umsetzungskompetenz.

Benefits

  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: In der operativen Umsetzung der Energiewende verantwortest Du eigene Projekte – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Wachstum & Perspektive: In einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld mit Private-Equity-Hintergrund und in einer zukunftssicheren Branche fördern wir deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung und eröffnen dir langfristige Perspektiven.

  • Vergütung & Erfolgsbeteiligung: Neben einer attraktiven Vergütung profitierst Du über unser Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm direkt am Unternehmenserfolg.

  • Urlaub & Flexibilität: 30 Tage Urlaub bei einer 5-Tage-Woche, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten.

  • Gesundheit & Mobilität: Angebote rund um Gesundheitsförderung sowie JobRad-Leasing.

  • Teamkultur & Vergünstigungen: Regelmäßige Firmenevents und gemeinsame Aktivitäten stärken den Zusammenhalt, Corporate Benefits bieten dir zusätzlich vielfältige Rabatte.
