title: Senior R&D Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

What to expect

To support the next phase of growth of its SNSPD platform, IDQ is looking for a Senior R&D Scientist to join its team in Geneva. This role targets a highly motivated PhD-level candidate with a strong background in experimental physics, optics, or engineering, and a drive to rethink and scale testing methodologies for advanced photonic devices. The position focuses on developing and implementing next-generation testing and metrology approaches to enable scalable, reliable, and high-throughput characterization of SNSPD technologies. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of device physics, optical testing, and system-level thinking, in close collaboration with R&D, engineering, and industrialization teams.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the development of advanced testing strategies for SNSPD devices, with a focus on scalability and throughput.
  • Rethink and optimize existing characterization methodologies, including possibly the transition toward wafer-level testing approaches.
  • Develop and operate optical and cryogenic measurement setups for device characterization.
  • Analyse and interpret complex datasets to guide device design and process improvements while driving experimental investigations to understand performance limits and variability across devices and wafers.
  • Collaborate closely with fabrication, packaging, and system teams to ensure test compatibility with manufacturing flows.
  • Document methodologies, results, and best practices in a structured and transferable way.

What you'll bring

  • Master’s degree in Physics, Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in experimental physics or a related field.
  • Strong foundation in hands-on experimental work or engineering.
  • Proven experience testing and characterizing optical or photonic systems (e.g., optoelectronic devices, waveguides, or similar platforms).
  • Solid understanding of measurement science and metrology principles, with experience designing or improving experimental setups.
  • Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to extract meaningful insights from complex measurements.
  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Fluent in English, with French considered a plus.

You'll be a great fit with

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Physics, Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • A strong hands-on background in optics or photonics experimental work.
  • 5+ years of experience working in industry.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
 
We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  

US Non-Technical Jobs. Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!

title: (Senior) Recruiting Manager / Personalberater (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Dragon & Gries

Als Deutschlands führende Personalberatung im Bereich Konzernsteuern vernetzen wir hochqualifizierte Spezialisten und Führungskräfte mit erstklassigen Arbeitgebern aus Industrie und Beratung.

Zusätzlich zu unserem stark etablierten Inhouse-Segment erweitern wir aktuell gezielt unsere Partnerschaften mit Steuerberatungs- und Beratungsgesellschaften sowie Kanzleien. Um dieses Geschäftsfeld eigenverantwortlich mitzugestalten und strategisch voranzutreiben, suchen wir eine erfahrene Beraterpersönlichkeit aus dem Recruiting-Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ganzheitliche Mandatsführung: Du verantwortest eigenständig Suchmandate im Bereich Tax und begleitest den gesamten Prozess – von der ersten Recherche bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Kundenbetreuung & Beratung: Du betreust bestehende Mandate bei Kanzleien, Steuerberatungsgesellschaften sowie weiteren Beratungshäusern und stehst deinen Ansprechpartnern beratend zur Seite.

  • Business Development: Du vertiefst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, erschließt neue Geschäftsfelder und baust dir schrittweise dein eigenes, nachhaltiges Mandatsportfolio auf.

  • Active Sourcing & Direktansprache: Du identifizierst passende Fach- und Führungskräfte für anspruchsvolle Vakanzen und sprichst potenzielle Kandidaten direkt und telefonisch an.

  • Auswahl & Interviewführung: Du führst strukturierte Kandidatengespräche, bewertest fachliche sowie persönliche Profile und steuerst den weiteren Auswahlprozess.

  • Präsentation & Verhandlungsführung: Du stellst geeignete Kandidaten bei deinen Mandanten vor, koordinierst Interviewrunden und begleitest Feedbackschleifen sowie Vertragsverhandlungen.

  • Langfristige Partnerschaft: Auch nach der erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibst du vertrauensvolle Kontaktperson für deine Kunden und platzierten Kandidaten.Das bringst du mit

Dein Markt

Dein Fokus liegt auf hochkarätigen Suchmandaten in den Bereichen Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung, Rechtsberatung sowie angrenzenden Professional Services.

Auf Kandidatenseite berätst du vor allem erfahrene Steuerberater (m/w/d), Rechtsanwälte (m/w/d) sowie hochspezialisierte Fach- und Führungskräfte aus dem Steuerumfeld. Dabei bewegst du dich überwiegend auf der Ebene von (Senior) Managern, Directors und Partnern. Die zu besetzenden Positionen liegen regelmäßig im attraktiven sechsstelligen Bereich – angefangen bei rund 100.000 Euro Jahresgehalt bis hin zu Partnerrollen mit 500.000 Euro und darüber.

Dieses Umfeld erfordert Beratung auf höchstem Niveau: Eine seriöse Direktansprache, fundiertes Wissen über Karrierepfade und Vergütungsmodelle sowie ein souveränes Auftreten gegenüber erfahrenen Führungskräften und Partnern prägen deinen Arbeitsalltag.

Das bringst du mit

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Beraterpersönlichkeit, die eigenverantwortlich agiert und gerne Verantwortung für eigene Mandate sowie Kundenbeziehungen übernimmt.

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Praxis im Recruiting, in der Personalberatung oder im Executive Search mit.

  • Branchenkenntnis: Idealerweise konntest du bereits Erfahrungen im Umfeld Tax, Finance oder Legal Recruiting sammeln.

  • Sourcing-Stärke: Die aktive und direkte Ansprache von Kandidaten gehört für dich selbstverständlich zum Alltag.

  • Prozesssicherheit: Du bist geübt darin, Suchprozesse von Anfang bis Ende selbstständig zu steuern und Mandanten auf Augenhöhe zu beraten.

  • Vertriebs- & Beziehungsstärke: Du hast Spaß daran, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen, neues Geschäft zu erschließen und deinen eigenen Erfolg aktiv voranzutreiben.

  • Souveränes Auftreten: Gegenüber erfahrenen Fach- und Führungskräften, Partnern sowie Entscheidern kommunizierst du überzeugend und professionell.

  • Arbeitsweise: Ein strukturierter, verlässlicher Arbeitsstil und ein hoher eigener Qualitätsanspruch runden dein Profil ab.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Bei erwartet dich die Chance, ein spannendes Marktsegment aktiv mitzugestalten und deine bisherige Beratungserfahrung direkt wirksam einzusetzen. Du greifst auf ein starkes Netzwerk sowie gewachsene Kundenkontakte im Steuerumfeld zurück und genießt gleichzeitig den unternehmerischen Freiraum, dein persönliches Mandatsportfolio gezielt zu erweitern.

  • Verantwortung & Freiraum: Eigenständige Steuerung deiner Mandate und Kundenbeziehungen bei kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Spannende Projekte: Anspruchsvolle Suchmandate im Professional-Services-Sektor mit direktem Draht zu Entscheidern, Partnern und erstklassigen Kandidaten.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Gleitzeit, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und 30 Tage Jahresurlaub für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Zeitgemäßes technisches Equipment sowie kostenfreie Parkplätze direkt vor Ort.

  • Teamkultur & Verpflegung: Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents sowie freie Getränke und Snacks im Büro.

Überdurchschnittliche Verdienstmöglichkeiten

Zusätzlich zu einem attraktiven Fixum erwartet dich ein transparentes, leistungsorientiertes Vergütungsmodell mit hervorragenden Einkommenschancen.

Dein Gehalt wächst direkt mit deinen eigenen Erfolgen: Wenn du neue Mandate akquirierst, Kundenbeziehungen ausbaust und Positionen erfolgreich besetzt, wirst du daran unmittelbar beteiligt. Da sich die von uns vermittelten Fach- und Führungskräfte sowie Partner in sehr hohen Einkommensklassen bewegen, ergeben sich durch die entsprechenden Honorare überdurchschnittliche Verdienstmöglichkeiten.

Deine Perspektive bei Dragon & Gries

Bei uns bekommst du den Raum, dein eigenes Markt- und Kundenfeld langfristig aufzubauen und strategisch zu prägen. Du übernimmst einerseits bereits bestehende Kundenkontakte und gewinnst andererseits neue Kanzleien sowie Beratungsgesellschaften als Partner für Dragon & Gries hinzu. Mit dem Wachstum deines Geschäfts steigen sowohl dein Verantwortungsbereich als auch deine wirtschaftliche Beteiligung im Unternehmen kontinuierlich an.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Select UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team.

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.
  • Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.
  • Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent
  • Consistent track record selling complex solutions
  • Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win.
  • Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments
  • Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems
  • Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience
  • IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus
  • Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Qualifikation

Benefits

Was diese Position bietet

title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You’ll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you’ll be doing

In this role, you’ll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You’ll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt’s selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners’ businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt’s long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You’re an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You’re comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You’re highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You’re comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt’s Retail growth. You’ll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You’ll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You’ll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you’d be excited about, we’d love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We’ll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself.

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver

  • Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

  • Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

  • Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

  • Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

  • Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

  • Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

  • Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

  • Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

  • Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate

  • Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

  • Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

  • Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

  • Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

  • Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

  • Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

  • Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes


Job Requirements

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred

  • Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages

  • Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar

  • Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs

  • Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

  • Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex

  • Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry

  • Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies

  • SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne

  • SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar

  • Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation

  • Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment

  • Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases

  • Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar

  • Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments

  • Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response

  • Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations

  • General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

Job Specifics

  • Location: This is a hybrid role, while the role is primarily remote, typically 70% to 80% percent of the time, there will be a requirement to travel to customer sites and attend the Basingstoke office as required to support delivery, workshops and engagements.

    (free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!).

  • Hours are full-time: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm. There is no on-call requirement for this position.

Why would you choose to come and work with us?

You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment, working across a wide range of customer environments and technologies. The role offers exposure to real-world threats, modern detection approaches, and the opportunity to shape how Security Operations capabilities are designed and delivered.

Nomios offers a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and industry-leading benefits, along with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how we and our customers build and run Security Operations.

Nomios is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and sustaining an environment in which everyone is provided with an equal opportunity to grow and develop, and no individual will be unjustly discriminated against. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion and belief, sex and sexual orientation.

descriptionHtml:

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Platform Engineering at GoCardless

The Platform Engineering team is a unified, globally distributed team, currently located in London, Riga and Lisbon. We work with all other engineering teams to empower them to build, release, run and scale their products, with a strong focus on both strategic project delivery and operational excellence.

Our work is a balance of:

  • Project delivery: building new platform components, from initial design to deployment.
  • Operational support: keeping our systems healthy and stable through on-call rotations and incident management.
  • Business as usual: continuous maintenance, improvements, and support for audits and compliance.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior SRE with deep PostgreSQL expertise to own the reliability, performance and scalability of our database estate. Our databases sit at the heart of a payments platform, so slowdowns and outages directly affect our customers.

You’ll work across our self-managed Stolon clusters and our GCP Cloud SQL fleet. Joining Mollie gives us the opportunity to consolidate, modularise and rethink how we run production databases, and you’ll help us do that while keeping everything reliable.

What excites you

What excites us

Skills

  • Experience in payments or financial services

We hope you’re enthusiastic about the infrastructure space and the impact your work can have on others. In this role:

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defense capability.

About the Job

Senior Software Engineers independently drive the delivery of a variety of embedded and/or safety critical software integrated in to our products. This includes device management, drivers, firmware, power management, networking, and contingency management and recovery. We expect Senior Software Engineers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership at the major subsystem or system level. Senior Software Engineers contribute as a technical lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

  • Contribute to the design and development of existing software components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines
  • Develop real-time embedded software using an RTOS.
  • Develop device drivers and interfaces to a variety of sensors and actuators.
  • Create test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software-and hardware-in-the-loop.
  • Support vehicle manufacturing and deployment.
  • Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for Software Engineers from differing backgrounds
  • Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Experienced and proficient at low lever programming languages such as C, C++ or Rust.
  • Experience with an RTOS.
  • Familiarity with communications busses and protocols (e.g. one or more of CAN, CANFD, UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI, QSPI, I2C, UDP, TCP, Ethernet )
  • Systems programming skills including algorithms, data structures, concurrency and optimization.
  • Capacity to act as the technical owner for a software component, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution
  • Capacity to learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, contributing to team cohesion and capacity.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active Australian Government security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in design and development of embedded applications in autonomous vehicle software systems.
  • Experience with development of high assurance safety critical software applications.
  • Experience in developing interfaces to sensors and actuators.
  • Experience troubleshooting and analyzing remotely deployed software systems.
  • Experience working with and testing electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Experience with DO-178, IEC 61508, or similar certifications.
  • Experience with NixOS
  • Familiarity with navigation and communications systems.
  • Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Familiarity with Systems Engineering concepts
  • Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Software Engineer, such as Staff Software Engineer and/or Software Engineering Manager
  • Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

WHY CATAPULT?

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET Ecosystem)
descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. Each client has a primary owner, but no client belongs to one person: we review and co-maintain across languages and decide cross-client questions together.

The role

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own the ClickHouse .NET client. You'll decide what the client should do by talking to the developers who use it, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep .NET expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: ADO.NET, Dapper and Entity Framework Core users, and the tools and integrations that depend on your client.

What you'll do

  • Know who uses the client and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap.

  • Be the voice of ClickHouse for .NET developers. Speak at .NET conferences and meet-ups, and write the posts, tutorials and samples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from .NET (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them.

  • Own the .NET client and its ecosystem: the client, the EF Core provider and ORM integrations, NuGet releases and support. Evolve it without breaking the people who depend on it.

  • Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features.

  • Bring what .NET and Windows users need to the ODBC driver, since that's how many Windows and BI tools reach ClickHouse. If you write C++, contribute to it directly.

  • Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

  • Make the client enterprise-ready: TLS and certificate handling, authentication including Microsoft Entra ID, safe credential handling, signed and reproducible packages, and the audit and compliance questions large .NET shops ask before they adopt.

  • Shape the client for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

  • Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.

About you

  • Product-minded. You decide what to build from user evidence, measure whether it worked, and can explain what you chose not to build.

  • 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, data access, ingestion or analytics.

  • Deep C# and .NET expertise: memory management, async and the TPL, Span and pooling, profiling and benchmarking. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks.

  • Fluent in C#, and productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++). You'll review and co-own across clients, not only .NET.

  • You've built or substantially extended a library other engineers depend on, and shipped NuGet packages across .NET Framework and modern .NET. You treat breaking changes accordingly.

  • Fluent in .NET data access (ADO.NET, Dapper, EF Core) and at home in the wider .NET ecosystem: ASP.NET Core, Aspire, NuGet.

  • Security-minded. You've shipped a library into enterprise environments and know what security, compliance and procurement teams look for in a dependency.

  • Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it.

  • Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out.

  • Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs.

Nice to have

  • ClickHouse, especially its type system, or another OLAP engine.

  • C++ and ODBC driver internals.

  • Building or maintaining an ADO.NET or EF Core provider.

  • Open-source contributions to .NET or data infrastructure.

  • Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer.

  • Protocol or wire-format work on a database driver or network client.

Learn more

  • Introducing the (blazing fast!) native TCP client for .NET: zero-copy columnar reads, 1.5 to 2x faster than HTTP, over 99% fewer GC allocations (Oct 2026)

  • What's new in the ClickHouse .NET Driver: the road from 1.0 to 1.3 (Aug 2026)

  • Meet GroeneAI: our autonomous contributor to ClickHouse (Oct 2026)

  • Building a .NET API Gateway with ClickHouse and Aspire (Jun 2026)

  • The .NET client on GitHub and its documentation

  • ClickHouse Workload for Microsoft Fabric, now in public preview (Sep 2026)

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

  • Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

  • Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

  • Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

  • Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

  • Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

  • Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

  • Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

  • Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

  • Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

  • Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

  • Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

  • First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

  • First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

  • First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

  • You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

  • You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

  • We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

  • We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

  • We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

  • Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

  • A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

  • Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

  • Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

  • Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

  • Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

  • The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

  • Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

  • Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

  • Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups

  • Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce)

  • Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

  • Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Shape the platform, not just tickets: your insights from customers will directly impact what our engineering teams build.

  • Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched.

  • Help build the team: you'll join a small team at an inflection point, with real ownership over how Solutions Engineering works at WeTravel.


    Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events.

  • Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden and right by Rokin metro.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account.

  • Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation

Ready to build something meaningful? Apply now.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. We believe great UX is not just about usability—it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.

As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows—from search to synthesis to decision-making. We partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex data and advanced AI capabilities into cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality experiences.

Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer to join our growing team and play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a Staff-level individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through design craft, systems thinking, and a deep understanding of our customers’ workflows.

In this role, you will drive strategic design initiatives—translating complex, data-rich problems into intuitive, high-quality experiences that feel tailored to how our customers actually work. You’ll bring clarity to ambiguity, define end-to-end workflows, and ensure our product experiences are cohesive, scalable, and grounded in real user needs.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to shape how capabilities come together into meaningful user experiences — from early concept through execution. You’ll balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints, ensuring we deliver experiences that are not only functional, but differentiated through quality and usability.

As a senior member of the Design team, you’ll act as a multiplier, mentoring other designers, contributing to our design systems and patterns, and helping raise the bar for craft and consistency across the product. You’ll play a critical role in defining how we deliver AI-native workflows, ensuring they are intuitive, trustworthy, and seamlessly integrated into our customers’ day-to-day work.

This role is an opportunity to help establish the foundations of a truly workflow-centric, AI-powered product experience — one that enables our customers to move from information to insight to decision with speed and confidence.

Why this role matters:

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make decisions.

In this role, you will help set that standard through the experiences you design, the systems you strengthen, and the team you help elevate.

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in interaction design, systems thinking, and delivering high-quality, user-centered experiences.

  • Strong awareness of emerging AI and search technologies, with curiosity and initiative to apply new capabilities to real product experiences.
  • Proven ability to lead complex projects end-to-end, navigate ambiguity, and drive clarity across cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing other designers, helping raise the bar for craft, systems thinking, and execution.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly curious, thoughtful, and driven, able to quickly build context, form strong points of view, and push work forward.
  • Experience in financial services, investment workflows, or data-heavy SaaS products is a plus.

What You’ll Do:

  • Deliver high-fidelity prototypes, interaction models, and end-to-end experiences that clearly communicate product vision and drive strategic alignment across stakeholders.
  • Transform customer insights from interviews, surveys, and usability testing into actionable product direction, championing customer empathy throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Define and drive design strategy for key initiatives, ensuring alignment with company goals and a clear connection between user needs, business outcomes, and product direction.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex requirements into intuitive, high-quality user experiences that scale.
  • Deliver exceptionally crafted solutions while elevating design quality across the team by contributing to the design system, evolving patterns, and shaping best practices.
  • Design for systems, not just screens, working within and advancing a growing design system to ensure consistency, scalability, and cohesion across the product.
  • Stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and AI capabilities, applying new ideas to continuously improve product experiences.
  • Communicate complex ideas with clarity and influence, ensuring alignment and momentum across cross-functional partners.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering throughout development, advocating for design quality and ensuring a high bar for execution, usability, and attention to detail.

title: Senior Strategic Consultant
descriptionHtml:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

A quick snapshot 

As a Conga Solution Consultant, you will help drive continued growth for an innovative, rapidly growing enterprise software company. You will help a variety of B2B companies improve their pricing and margins, including manufacturers, distributors, cargo and logistics providers. You will partner with Sales to understand each customers' business and challenges, shape solutions to those challenges, and set both sides up for long-term success, in a market you will help shape and lead. There is significant room to grow at Conga and your advancement will reflect the impact you make to the Pre-Sales organization. 

Why it's a big deal 

Pre-Sales showcases Conga’s products to prospects, customers, partners, and the market in ways that improve their daily work, earn them a career “win,” and set Conga apart from competitors. No two days are alike: you will build expertise in a growing market, in enterprise applications like Conga’s, in the CRMs and ERPs they connect to, and in the APIs that link them. You will work with every team in the company, including marketing, product, sales, and development. As a trusted advisor to senior business and technical leaders, you will contribute to our sales growth.  

What you will do 

  • Take responsibility for the pre-sales process alongside the Account Executive, guiding prospects from initial solution design to a decision to purchase. 
  • Lead structured discovery workshops on pricing and revenue management: price setting and governance, discounting and approvals, price optimization, rebates and incentives, and the customer's wider commercial ecosystem. 
  • Map customer needs to Conga's pricing and revenue solutions (price management and optimization, rebate management, and where relevant CPQ, CLM and AiMe) and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations. 
  • Build value cases, business cases and ROI/TCO models that show prospects how they grow margin and yield with Conga. 
  • Lead technical qualification and fit/gap analysis, and contribute to RFI/RFP responses and proofs of concept, including integration with ERP and other business systems. 
  • Help build Conga's position in the Cargo industry: bring or develop a point of view, use cases and demo scenarios for cargo pricing and revenue management, and support cargo opportunities. 
  • Provide thought leadership on pricing best practices, present at customer events and conferences, and act as a recognised pricing expert. 
  • Feed field insight back to Product, Marketing and Sales, and share demo assets and best practices with fellow Solution Consultants. 

Are you the person we're looking for? 

  • Pre-sales experience. 5+ years as a pre-sales engineer or solution consultant for an enterprise software application, ideally in pricing, revenue management or Quote-to-Cash, including configuring and delivering software demonstrations. 
  • Pricing and revenue acumen. A solid understanding of B2B pricing, price optimization and revenue management, gained in pre-sales, consulting or a pricing team. 
  • Champion of the customer. You conduct discovery workshops and genuinely listen before you present. 
  • A good eye for data interpretation. Excellent analytical and quantitative skills: you turn customer data, market context and pain points into clear advice and a compelling demo. 
  • Business case skills. Experience building business cases and ROI/TCO models. 
  • Clear, deliberate, collaborative communicator. Strong written and verbal communication, in front of a boardroom or a technical team. You balance a "take charge, do-whatever-it-takes" attitude with teamwork. 
  • Expert relationship builder. You enjoy building relationships with key internal and external partners to deliver beneficial outcomes for customers. 
  • Tech-savvy. Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, in particular Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, and with how pricing and quoting processes connect to them. Experience with an enterprise pricing or revenue management solution or a complex BI application is a strong asset. Experience with APIs is a plus. 
  • Proactive self-starter and willing to travel. You take initiative and drive your own goals, and you are able and willing to support in-person customer meetings, events and conferences (around 25%). 

What will give you an edge 

  • Cargo revenue management expertise. Understanding of cargo pricing and revenue management techniques (rate and tariff structures, contract versus spot, block space agreements and allotments, yield and capacity management, surcharges) and of the cargo ecosystem of airlines, forwarders, GSAs and handlers. Experience in a cargo commercial or revenue management team, or at a cargo software vendor, is a real plus. 
  • Adjacent products. Experience with CPQ, CLM, contract management or document automation, and with extending applications on the Salesforce (force.com) platform. 
  • Related experience. Collaborating with systems integrators and working on large project teams, plus familiarity with ERP integration and API-focused solutions. 
  • Languages. A second European language, French or German in particular. 

Did we pique your interest?  

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you! 

Preferred Resume Format 

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. 

Don’t meet every requirement for the role? 

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.  

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

title: Service Desk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: C1

Team: Client Support

Salary: £30,400 - £45,600 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Client Support Lead

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

 

You’ll work mainly on the Kaluza Energy Retail platform, a single-instance SaaS platform built for scale and technical quality. It’s the foundation for our customers’ decarbonisation work, and we’re now moving it to a multi-tenant, international-ready model so we can take on new challenges and external customers. This is a technical role, so you’ll need to pick up new and existing technologies quickly.

 

  • Triage and prioritise support tickets from retailers’ agents based on impact and urgency, using Jira as our service desk tool, and deliver first-time fixes for repeat issues.

  • Be the go-to person for impact assessments and root cause analysis. You’ll identify affected accounts or processes and recommend technical fixes through the Kaluza incident process.

  • Use sources such as Databricks, Jira and Google Data Studio to spot trends, measure the impact of issues and diagnose the root cause of client tickets.

  • Act quickly to stop incidents from getting worse, and support our Problem and Incident Managers throughout the lifecycle of an incident or problem.

  • Raise high-quality incidents and problem candidates for product teams, and work with them to get updates and solutions back to customers.

  • Manage internal and external stakeholders, setting clear expectations, giving timely updates and working to team KPIs.

  • Help define what a great Service Desk looks like at Kaluza.

 

This role includes a place on a 24/7 on-call rota, one week at a time.


What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

 

  • Experience in the energy industry in the UK, Belgium or France.

  • Experience investigating support issues and identifying root causes and affected accounts or processes.

 

Ideally, you’ll have:

 

  • Experience in a service desk, technical support or similar role, triaging and prioritising tickets using Jira or a similar tool.

  • Basic Python scripting skills and experience working with APIs.

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude in your day-to-day work.

  • Experience supporting incident and problem management processes (e.g. ITIL)

  • Experience analysing data with SQL, using tools such as Databricks.

Tech stack: Jira, Databricks, SQL, Python, Google Data Studio

 

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.
